ref-dropbox.summary: Dropbox pays for referrals in extra storage rather than cash. When someone you invite creates a new account through your link and finishes setting up the app, you both get bonus space added to your accounts. It suits people on a personal Dropbox plan who already recommend the service to friends, family or classmates.
ref-dropbox.whoItsFor: Individual Dropbox users on Basic, Plus, Family or Professional plans who want more storage without paying for an upgrade. Accounts on Dropbox team plans cannot send referrals.
howItPays: Basic accounts earn 500 MB for each completed referral, up to 16 GB in total, per Dropbox's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Plus, Family and Professional accounts earn 1 GB for each completed referral, up to 32 GB in total, per Dropbox's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The friend who signs up through your link also receives 500 MB of bonus space, per Dropbox's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The reward is storage only, with no cash or credit option. It is added once the referral status in your settings shows as Completed.
eligibility: Referrers need a personal Dropbox account; team plan accounts cannot send referrals.
The friend must be new to Dropbox. A referral is marked Ineligible if the person already has an account or signs up from the same computer you use.
The friend must sign up through your link, install the Dropbox app, sign in from it, and verify their email address.
If someone receives invites from several people, only the person whose link they actually used gets credit.
steps: 1. Sign in at dropbox.com and open Settings from your avatar, then choose Refer a friend.
2. Copy your invite link or send email invites from that page (Basic users can also invite from the mobile app).
3. Share the link with people you know who could use cloud storage.
4. Ask your friend to install the Dropbox app, sign in, and confirm their email.
5. Check the Refer a friend page, where each invite shows its status and your total bonus space.
tips: Tell friends up front that installing the app and verifying their email are required; most stalled referrals sit at Waiting for install or Waiting for email verification.
If you are close to the Basic cap, note that paid personal plans have a higher per-referral amount and a higher total cap.
Sharing a folder with someone does not count as a referral, so send the invite link itself.
Invite people who will actually use Dropbox; a quick explanation of why you use it is more persuasive than a bare link.
watchOuts: Dropbox's Acceptable Use Policy bars abusing referrals or promotions to get more space than deserved, and bars sending spam.
Bonus space stops at the cap for your plan type; extra referrals beyond it add nothing.
Sign-ups from your own computer or by people who already had an account will not count.

faq.q: Does my friend have to use the same email I invited?
faq.a: No. Dropbox's help center says the friend must sign up through your link, but they can use a different email address than the one you sent the invite to.

faq.q: Why does my referral say Ineligible?
faq.a: Usually because the person already had a Dropbox account or signed up from the same computer you use. Dropbox treats those as not new users.

faq.q: Can I refer people from a Dropbox team account?
faq.a: No. Dropbox says accounts on team plans cannot send referrals, so you would need a personal account to take part.

ref-dropbox.publicPostingNote: Dropbox's help pages set no specific rule on where links may be posted, but its Acceptable Use Policy bans spam and referral abuse.

ref-revolut.summary: Revolut runs invite campaigns inside its app: you send a personal link, and if your friend opens a new personal account and completes a short task list before the deadline, you get a cash reward. The amount, deadline and number of paid referrals are set in each invite, so details differ by person and country.
ref-revolut.whoItsFor: Existing Revolut Personal customers who see an invite offer in their app and know people who would genuinely use a Revolut account and card.
howItPays: The reward is a cash amount stated in your own in-app invite and paid in your account's base currency; Revolut's terms say it can vary by the invitee's country of residence.
Your friend must open a new Personal account through your link, add money from outside Revolut, order a physical card, and make a set number of card purchases above a minimum shown in the app.

Revolut's help center says you can earn rewards for up to 5 invitees per campaign, per Revolut's page, checked Nov 24, 2026; the terms add that any cap stated in your invite applies, and extra invitees earn nothing.
Payment timing is confirmed in the invite itself.
eligibility: Referrers need an active Revolut Personal account that has received an in-app referral invite and stays in good standing until payment.
Invitees must never have had a Revolut Personal account with any Revolut entity. Kids and Teens, Business and Joint accounts do not count.
Currency exchange, money transfers, gambling, gift card purchases and transfers between Revolut accounts do not count as qualifying activity.
steps: 1. In the Revolut app, open your profile and choose Invite friends to see your campaign's reward, deadline and purchase rules.
2. Send your personal link to someone you know who has agreed to hear about it.
3. Your friend signs up, verifies their identity, tops up, and orders a physical card.
4. Your friend makes the required card purchases before the deadline; completed steps turn green in the app.
5. Track progress on the Referrals screen.
tips: Share the exact task list with your friend so they know a physical card order and real card purchases are required.
Pending card payments count only once fully processed, so purchases should not be left to the last day.
Read the Terms & Conditions link inside your invite, since that campaign is the one that applies to you.
watchOuts: Revolut's terms say you must not mislead anyone, should only send invites to people you know who have agreed to receive them, and must not spam.
A reward can be withheld or reversed if the invitee undoes a step, for example closing the account within 14 days or refunding a qualifying purchase.
Card delivery or card fees may apply for your friend, depending on their plan and country.

Rewards can count as taxable income where you live, so keep a record of what you receive and check with a tax professional if you are unsure. If you or your friend use any investing or crypto features, those carry a risk of loss. This guide describes the program only and is not financial or investment advice.

faq.q: How much is the Revolut referral reward?
faq.a: It is set per person and shown in your in-app invite. Revolut's terms say it can vary by the invitee's country, so there is no single public figure.

faq.q: Do transfers between Revolut accounts count as the top-up?
faq.a: No. The money must come from a card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or a bank transfer from outside Revolut.

faq.q: Can I post my link on social media or a deal site?
faq.a: Revolut's terms ask you to send invites only to people you know who have agreed to receive them, so broad public posting does not fit the rules.

ref-revolut.publicPostingNote: Revolut's terms say to send invites only to people you know who agreed to receive them, with no spam or misleading claims.

ref-wise.summary: Wise lets customers invite friends with a personal link. The friend gets a discount to try Wise, such as a free transfer or, in some regions, a free card, and you earn a reward when invited friends qualify through cross-currency transfers or card spending. It suits regular Wise users who know people who send money abroad or travel.
ref-wise.whoItsFor: Personal Wise customers in good standing who have friends or family with real international money needs.
howItPays: Wise calls rewards Referral Fees; the current amount, how many qualifying friends are needed, and the qualifying spend are shown on your invite page and can change at any time.
Your friend qualifies with an international transfer between different currencies or with Wise card spending; the help center says spending can add up across several transactions.
Wise emails you after you qualify. You must claim within one year of qualifying, or the reward expires.
You can pick from most currencies Wise supports when you claim.
eligibility: Referrers must be Wise customers in good standing using the program for personal, not commercial, purposes.
Invitees must be new to Wise; a recent sign-up can count only if they add your link within 30 days of signing up.
The program is not offered in every country, and some offers set a deadline for friends to qualify.
Same-currency transfers, conversions between your own balances, cash-like transactions, gambling, investment or crypto payments, and pending card payments do not count.
steps: 1. Sign in to Wise and open your invite page, where your personal link and current offer appear.
2. Share the link with family or friends who have asked about sending money abroad or spending in other currencies.
3. Your friend signs up through the link and gets their welcome discount.
4. Your friend completes a qualifying cross-currency transfer or card spend before any deadline shown.
5. Follow progress on the Track referrals page, then claim the reward from Wise's email within a year.
tips: Explain that only cross-currency activity counts; a same-currency payment will not move the referral forward.
Point friends to the days-remaining counter on the tracking page so they do not miss a deadline.
Claim promptly once Wise emails you, since unclaimed rewards expire after a year.
watchOuts: Wise's terms ban posting your link on coupon or voucher code sites, on forums or social channels that reach beyond family and friends, and in paid search.
Opening extra accounts to invite yourself, or using other contact details to do so, is banned and can lead to forfeiture of all rewards.
Wise may ask for ID before paying and can withhold or recover rewards it considers abused.

Rewards can count as taxable income where you live, so keep a record of what you receive and check with a tax professional if you are unsure. If you or your friend use any investing or crypto features, those carry a risk of loss. This guide describes the program only and is not financial or investment advice.

faq.q: What does my friend get?
faq.a: A discount to try Wise. Depending on the region, that is a free transfer or a choice between a free transfer and a free card. Free transfer vouchers cover Wise's own fee, not outside costs.

faq.q: Is there a limit on how many people I can invite?
faq.a: Wise's help center says you can invite as many people as you like and can earn the reward more than once, though the reward rules on your invite page apply.

faq.q: Can I share my link on a public forum?
faq.a: No. Wise's terms limit sharing to family and friends and specifically exclude forums and social channels that reach beyond them.

ref-wise.publicPostingNote: Wise's terms prohibit coupon and voucher sites, public forums or social channels beyond family and friends, and paid search.

ref-uberaff.summary: The Uber Affiliate Program pays website and app owners a commission when people they send to Uber take a first ride or place a first Uber Eats order. It is an application-based partnership, not a friend referral code, and Uber decides rates individually after accepting a partner. It suits publishers with real traffic in travel, food, city guides or similar topics.
ref-uberaff.whoItsFor: Owners of websites or apps with an active audience and the ability to track referrals; Uber says not every applicant is accepted.
howItPays: Commissions are earned for new users who complete their first Uber trip or place their first Uber Eats order.
Uber does not publish a standard rate; its page says the commission depends on your audience, the country you operate in and other factors, and can be discussed once you join.
Uber's page also mentions a separate track that pays for new drivers and couriers who complete a first trip.
Payout schedule and method are not listed on the public page; expect them in the agreement you receive if accepted.
eligibility: Applicants are vetted on brand safety, number of active users, tracking capabilities and media cost, among other factors.
The program is aimed at websites and apps rather than individual riders sharing an invite code.
Joining is free, and the application form is offered in English only.
steps: 1. Review Uber's affiliate program page to confirm your site or app fits its criteria.
2. Gather basics about your property: audience size, countries served, traffic sources and how you track conversions.
3. Complete the application form linked from the page.
4. If accepted, review the commission terms Uber offers for your audience and region.
5. Add your tracking links to relevant content and monitor first-trip and first-order conversions.
tips: Place links where they help readers, such as airport transfer guides or local food roundups, rather than in unrelated content.
Be ready to explain how you measure traffic and conversions, since tracking capability is one of Uber's stated criteria.
Disclose clearly that you may earn a commission when readers sign up through your links.
Ask during onboarding which promotion methods and regions are allowed before you launch.
watchOuts: Approval is not guaranteed, and the public page gives no commission figures to plan around.
Commissions cover new users only, so links shown to existing Uber customers will not earn.
Rules on paid ads, coupon use and brand terms are not posted publicly; follow whatever agreement Uber gives you.

faq.q: Is this the same as the Uber invite code in the rider app?
faq.a: No. This is a separate partnership for website and app owners who apply and are approved, with commissions agreed individually.

faq.q: How much does Uber pay affiliates?
faq.a: Uber does not post a fixed rate. Its page says the commission depends on your audience, country and other factors, and is discussed after you join.

faq.q: Does it cost anything to join?
faq.a: Uber's page says there is no fee to join the program.

ref-uberaff.publicPostingNote: Promotion on your approved website or app is the purpose of the program; detailed promotion rules come in Uber's partner agreement.

ref-shopify.summary: The Shopify Affiliate Program pays creators, educators and publishers a commission when someone they refer starts a qualifying paid Shopify plan. It runs through the Impact partner platform, where approved affiliates get tracking links, reporting and payouts. It suits people who teach or write about ecommerce and already reach would-be store owners.
ref-shopify.whoItsFor: Content creators, course makers, publishers, commerce experts, app partners and Shopify merchants with an established audience interested in starting or growing an online store.
howItPays: Up to $150 USD per qualified referral, with the amount varying by the referral's location, per Shopify's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Commission is earned when the referred merchant buys a full-price Basic, Grow or Advanced plan; a free trial alone does not earn.
Referrals are tracked for 30 days from the click, and referrals who start a free trial are tracked for up to 400 days, per Shopify's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Commissions are credited to your balance on the 22nd of each month for the previous month, and you can withdraw once your balance reaches $10 USD, per Shopify's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Payouts go by direct deposit or PayPal in most countries, either at a balance threshold you set or every two weeks.
eligibility: Anyone may apply, but Shopify says it prioritizes quality and relevance and does not approve every application.
Shopify looks for an active website, an established audience, original commerce or entrepreneurship content and familiarity with commerce platforms.
Applicants without an active site or audience, or with content that does not fit Shopify's brand, may be declined.
steps: 1. Read the program page and compliance guidelines so you know the rules before applying.
2. Apply through the Impact link on Shopify's affiliates page; joining is free.
3. Watch for an approval email; Shopify says most applications are processed within about 24 hours.
4. Log in to your Impact dashboard to get custom links and promotional materials.
5. Add links to tutorials, reviews or courses, with a clear affiliate disclosure.
6. Track referrals and set your payout preferences in the dashboard.
tips: Create practical content, such as setup walkthroughs or theme comparisons, that helps readers decide whether Shopify fits them.
Use the long free-trial tracking window to your advantage by helping trial users succeed rather than chasing clicks.
Put a plain disclosure near each link, such as noting that you may earn a commission if readers sign up.
Vet any partner or paid traffic source, because Shopify holds you responsible for all traffic on your links.
watchOuts: Bidding on Shopify brand terms or misspellings in paid search is prohibited, and Shopify asks affiliates to add Shopify as a negative keyword.
Posing as Shopify, using Shopify in a promotional domain, hidden cookie tricks and sub-affiliate networks are not allowed.
Loyalty and browser-extension affiliates may not promote promo codes or coupons, and extensions need written approval.
Breaking the guidelines can lead to forfeited commissions or removal from the program.

faq.q: Do I get paid when someone starts a free trial?
faq.a: Not on its own. Commission is earned when the referred merchant buys a full-price qualifying plan, though trial sign-ups are tracked for a long window.

faq.q: Is there a cap on commissions?
faq.a: Shopify's affiliate page states there are no commission caps.

faq.q: What disclosure should I use?
faq.a: Shopify's guidelines ask you to say that you are a Shopify affiliate and may earn a commission, wherever your link appears, and not to imply that Shopify employs or endorses you.

ref-shopify.publicPostingNote: Public promotion is the point of the program, with bans on brand-term bidding, impersonation and some coupon uses.

ref-amazon-assoc.summary: Amazon Associates is Amazon's long-running affiliate program for websites, blogs and apps. You link to products on Amazon, and when a visitor buys qualifying items within the tracking window, you earn a commission that depends on the product category. It suits publishers who write reviews, buying guides or tutorials that naturally recommend products.
ref-amazon-assoc.whoItsFor: Bloggers, publishers and creators with a qualifying website or mobile app; established social media influencers are pointed to Amazon's separate Influencer Program.
howItPays: Commissions run up to 10% depending on category, per Amazon's page, checked Nov 24, 2026. Examples from the standard rate table: 10% for Luxury Beauty, 4.5% for physical books and kitchen, 1% for grocery, 0% for gift cards, and 4% for categories not listed.
A click starts a 24-hour session; items added to the cart during that session still count if the order is placed within 89 days, per Amazon's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Commissions are paid roughly 60 days after the end of the month they were earned, per Amazon's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
In the US, direct deposit and gift card payouts need at least $10, while checks need at least $100 and carry a $15 processing fee, per Amazon's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: You need an approved website or mobile app with original content; Amazon reviews it for suitability.
Amazon reviews new accounts after they make at least three qualifying sales within the first 180 days, and personal orders do not count, per Amazon's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Rejected applications cannot be reassessed, according to Amazon's help center.
You may not buy through your own links or encourage friends, relatives or business contacts to do so.
steps: 1. Read the Operating Agreement and Program Policies before signing up.
2. Apply from the Associates Central homepage and list the sites or apps where you will place links.
3. Create product links with your Associates ID in your account tools.
4. Add links to helpful content and include a clear affiliate disclosure.
5. Work toward three qualifying sales in your first 180 days so your account can be reviewed.
6. Choose a payment method and watch earnings reports in Associates Central.
tips: Write honest comparisons and explain who a product suits; useful content earns trust and clicks.
Check the category rate table so you know what you will actually earn on the items you cover.
Keep price mentions general or follow Amazon's rules for showing prices, since prices change often.
Review the Operating Agreement periodically, as Amazon posts updates to it.
watchOuts: Links may not be used offline, in printed material or ebooks, or in emails and messages that recipients did not opt into.
Bidding on Amazon trademarks such as amazon or Kindle in paid search disqualifies the resulting purchases.
Redirect links that send people to Amazon without a click on your page, and links posted on Amazon itself, are not allowed.
Self-purchases through your own links are banned and can cost you your account.

faq.q: How long does an Amazon Associates link track?
faq.a: A session lasts 24 hours from the click. Items added to the cart in that time can still count if the order is completed within 89 days.

faq.q: When do I get paid?
faq.a: About 60 days after the end of the month in which you earned the commission, once you reach the minimum for your payment method.

faq.q: Can I share links on social media?
faq.a: Amazon focuses this program on approved sites and apps and points established influencers to its Influencer Program. Check that each place you post is listed in your account and follows the policies.

ref-amazon-assoc.publicPostingNote: Public posting on your approved sites is expected, with bans on offline use, unsolicited email, trademark bidding and redirects.

ref-acorns.summary: Acorns rewards customers who bring in new investors with a small bonus invested into both accounts. Your friend signs up through your personal link and makes a first investment, and after a verification period both of you receive Reward Shares. Acorns also runs occasional limited-time referral bonuses with larger, tiered amounts.
ref-acorns.whoItsFor: US-based Acorns customers in good standing who know people interested in starting to invest in small amounts.
howItPays: Under the standing Get $5, Give $5 promotion, you and your friend each receive $5 in Reward Shares once your friend qualifies, per Acorns's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Your friend qualifies by opening an account through your link and making an initial deposit or investment of $5 or more from a linked bank account; Round-Ups do not count, per Acorns's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Reward Shares are typically deposited 30 to 45 days after the friend's initial deposit settles, per Acorns's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Limited-time promotions with larger tiered bonuses for multiple referrals appear from time to time, each with its own registration window and rules; the most recent listed window closed November 22, 2026.
eligibility: Referrers must have at least one open Acorns account in good standing and be US residents or citizens living in the US, with limited exceptions for active-duty service members.
Referred friends must be new to Acorns and must sign up through your personal link or code.
Both accounts must stay in good standing through the promotion and until the reward is deposited.
Gift cards cannot fund the first investment, and there is no cash alternative to Reward Shares.
steps: 1. Open the Acorns app and find your personal referral link.
2. Get a friend's permission before texting or emailing them about Acorns.
3. Send the link; your friend signs up through it and opens an Invest account.
4. Your friend makes a first investment of at least $5 from a linked bank account.
5. Wait for verification, then look for the bonus on your Invest screen.
tips: Suggest your friend review Acorns's current plans and pricing before signing up, so the ongoing cost fits their budget and the $5 bonus is not the only reason to join.
Make sure your friend uses your link from the start, since the referral is tied to it.
If no bonus appears after the stated wait, contact Acorns Support rather than re-sending invites.
watchOuts: Acorns bans mass emailing, paid ads, bots, and posting referral links on websites, social media or event pages without written consent from Acorns.
You may not modify your link, sell referral links, or offer your own incentives to people who sign up.
Acorns can delay, withhold or claw back rewards if it suspects fraud or a rule violation.

Rewards can count as taxable income where you live, so keep a record of what you receive and check with a tax professional if you are unsure. Investing carries risk, including loss of the money you put in; a referral bonus should not be the reason to invest. This guide describes the program only and is not investment advice.

faq.q: Is the bonus paid in cash?
faq.a: No. It is invested as Reward Shares in the Acorns Invest account, and the terms say there is no cash alternative.

faq.q: Do Round-Ups count as my friend's first investment?
faq.a: No. Acorns's terms say the qualifying deposit of $5 or more must come from a linked bank account and excludes Round-Ups.

faq.q: Can I post my referral link on Instagram?
faq.a: Acorns's terms prohibit posting referral links on social media or websites without written consent from Acorns, so share it privately with people who agreed to hear from you.

ref-acorns.publicPostingNote: Acorns bans posting links on websites, social media or event pages, and ads or mass email, without its written consent.

ref-betterment.summary: Betterment's Refer a Friend program gives both people rewards when a new client funds an eligible account through a referral link. Depending on the accounts involved, rewards can include an investing bonus and a temporary boost to the Cash Reserve rate. It suits Betterment clients who know people looking for automated investing or a cash account.
ref-betterment.whoItsFor: US Betterment clients with a funded account who want to introduce people they know personally to the service.
howItPays: A $150 investing bonus for both you and your friend, per Betterment's page, checked Nov 24, 2026. Your friend qualifies with at least $100 deposited into a new individual automated investing account, taxable or IRA.

A Cash Reserve APY boost of 0.75% for 92 days on balances up to $1,000,000, triggered by a friend's deposit of at least $10 into a new Cash Reserve account, per Betterment's page, checked Nov 24, 2026. The base rate is variable.
The qualifying deposit must be made within 30 days of signup, and the investing bonus is paid around 30 days after the deposit settles if it stays funded, per Betterment's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Referrers can earn rewards for five referrals per calendar year; later referrals earn nothing until January 1, per Betterment's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: Referrers must be US residents with a funded Betterment account and hold a qualifying account with at least $10 when the friend deposits.
Friends must be new clients with no existing Betterment accounts and must use your link or code.
Self-directed, 401(k), joint, trust, HSA and Checking deposits do not qualify for the investing bonus, and some advised clients are excluded.
People disqualified under the SEC Marketing Rule cannot act as referrers.
steps: 1. Sign in to Betterment and open the Rewards Center to find your referral link or code.
2. Read the sender and recipient terms so you can describe the offer accurately.
3. Send the invite to someone you know personally, including the client disclosure Betterment requires.
4. Your friend opens a new eligible account through your link and makes the qualifying deposit within 30 days.
5. Watch for the bonus or rate boost on the reward date.
tips: Use Betterment's own referral page and email rather than writing your own claims about returns or features.
Tell your friend about the holding rules before they deposit.
Track how many referrals you have used this calendar year, since rewards stop after five.
watchOuts: Recipients who let the investing account fall below $250 within three years of the reward date may owe an early removal fee of up to $150.
Invites should go only to people you know personally, must carry Betterment's disclosure, and may not include personalized investment recommendations.

Betterment reports the investing bonus as interest for tax purposes. Rewards can count as taxable income where you live, so keep a record of what you receive and check with a tax professional if you are unsure.
Investing carries risk, including loss of the money you put in; a referral bonus should not be the reason to invest. This guide describes the program only and is not investment advice.

faq.q: Can I earn both the bonus and the rate boost?
faq.a: Possibly. Betterment's terms say you can earn one or both, depending on which qualifying accounts you hold when your friend funds theirs.

faq.q: Is there a limit on referrals?
faq.a: You can keep referring, but sender rewards are limited to five referrals per calendar year under the current terms.

faq.q: Does the bonus count toward my IRA contribution limit?
faq.a: Betterment's terms say it does not, though it may be taxable in some cases, such as a Roth conversion.

ref-betterment.publicPostingNote: Betterment's terms say to send invites only to people you know personally, with its required disclosure and no personalized advice.

ref-schwab.summary: Schwab's referral offer rewards people who open a new Schwab account using an existing client's referral code and bring in new assets. The bonus is tiered by the size of the net deposit made within 45 days. Schwab's public pages describe the bonus for the referred person and do not describe a reward for the client who refers.
ref-schwab.whoItsFor: Existing Schwab clients who want to introduce friends or family with meaningful savings to move, and new US investors who already plan to open a Schwab brokerage account or IRA.
howItPays: Referred friends can earn $100 for a net deposit of $25,000 to $49,999, $300 for $50,000 to $99,999, $500 for $100,000 to $499,999, and $1,000 for $500,000 or more, per Schwab's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The net deposit must be made into the enrolled account within 45 days of enrolling and must be outside assets new to Schwab, per Schwab's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Schwab's FAQ says rewards post about one to two weeks after the 45-day period ends.
For taxable accounts, the award is reported on Form 1099-INT.
eligibility: The referred person must be a US resident who does not already have a Schwab account (Stock Plan Services accounts excepted).
Schwab employees, contractors and their spouses are not eligible.

Eligible accounts include retail brokerage accounts and IRAs; Schwab Bank accounts, corporate accounts, education savings accounts and accounts managed by independent advisors are excluded, among others.
One offer per account and one enrolled account per client, though two new clients in one household can each qualify.
steps: 1. As an existing client, log in to Schwab and open the refer-a-friend area to get your referral code or link.
2. Share it with someone who is already considering a Schwab account.
3. Your friend enters the code while opening an eligible account.
4. Your friend makes the qualifying net deposit within 45 days.
5. The bonus posts after the 45-day window; if nothing appears 60 days after enrollment, Schwab gives a phone number on its page to call.
tips: Make sure your friend enters the code during account opening, since that is how the offer is enrolled.
Remind them that withdrawals or transfers out during the window reduce the net deposit that counts.
Do not expect a notice when your friend opens an account; Schwab says it does not notify referrers for privacy reasons.
watchOuts: For taxable accounts, the net deposit must stay at Schwab for at least one year or the bonus may be charged back.
The offer cannot be combined with other offers, is not transferable, and can be changed or ended without notice.

Rewards can count as taxable income where you live, so keep a record of what you receive and check with a tax professional if you are unsure. Schwab says any related taxes are the recipient's responsibility.
Investing carries risk, including loss of the money you put in; a referral bonus should not be the reason to invest. This guide describes the program only and is not investment advice.

faq.q: Does the person who refers get a bonus?
faq.a: Schwab's public referral pages describe the bonus for the referred person and do not describe a reward for the referring client.

faq.q: Do transfers from another Schwab account count?
faq.a: No. Only outside assets new to Schwab count toward the net deposit, with a narrow exception for Schwab Retirement Plan Services.

faq.q: Can I move an IRA to qualify?
faq.a: IRAs are eligible, but Schwab notes IRS rules may limit IRA-to-IRA rollovers in a one-year period, so check with a tax advisor first.

ref-schwab.publicPostingNote: Schwab's public pages say to share with friends and family but set no explicit rule on public posting.

ref-gemini.summary: Gemini, a crypto exchange, pays both the referrer and the new user in crypto when the new user makes a qualifying amount of trades soon after signing up. Rewards are managed from the Rewards area of the Gemini app or website, where you also choose which crypto to be paid in. It is available only in some countries, and offers differ outside the US.
ref-gemini.whoItsFor: Verified individual Gemini users in eligible regions who know people already interested in buying crypto.
howItPays: In the US, you and your friend each receive $50 in the crypto of your choice once the friend trades $100 within 30 days of registering, per Gemini's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Gemini's terms say these rewards are paid 32 days after sign-up, per Gemini's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Rewards at this tier are capped at USD $1,500 for US residents, per Gemini's page, checked Nov 24, 2026; the terms describe separate arrangements for larger referrers.
Deposits, withdrawals and stablecoin-to-stablecoin trades do not count toward the trading requirement.
eligibility: Referrals are offered only in certain jurisdictions; if you can see and use the Rewards section of your account, you can take part.
The friend must be a new user and complete ID verification; unverified accounts are not eligible.
Only individual accounts qualify, not joint, multi-user or institutional accounts.
steps: 1. Open the Rewards tab in the Gemini app, or Account then Rewards on the web.
2. Choose Refer friends and copy your personal link.
3. Share it with someone who already wants to use a crypto exchange.
4. Your friend signs up, verifies their identity, and completes the qualifying trades within 30 days.
5. Check the Rewards dashboard to follow the referral and the payout.
tips: Pick your reward crypto in the dashboard ahead of time, and remember its value can change after it lands.
Explain which trades count, so your friend does not rely on a deposit alone.
Keep a note of rewards received for tax time.
watchOuts: Self-referrals, duplicate accounts and other attempts to game the program are banned and can lead to disqualification and account suspension.
Gemini may delay, withhold, deny or revoke rewards it suspects are abusive.

Rewards can count as taxable income where you live, so keep a record of what you receive and check with a tax professional if you are unsure. Gemini says US users who earn over $600 in bonuses may receive a Form 1099-MISC.
Crypto prices can swing sharply and you can lose money; a referral bonus is never a reason to buy or trade. This guide describes the program only and is not investment advice.

faq.q: Can I share my Gemini link on social media?
faq.a: Yes. Gemini's terms allow sharing through social media, text, email or other platforms, though self-referrals and manipulation are banned.

faq.q: Does depositing money count as the qualifying activity?
faq.a: No. Gemini's terms say deposits and withdrawals do not count; the friend must complete trades that meet the minimum.

faq.q: Is the program available everywhere?
faq.a: No. Gemini offers referrals in limited jurisdictions, and rewards differ for customers outside the US.

ref-gemini.publicPostingNote: Gemini's terms allow sharing on social media and other platforms, while banning self-referrals and manipulation.

ref-kraken.summary: Kraken's referral program gives a bonus to both you and a new user you invite, once the new user signs up through your link in the Kraken app, deposits cash from a bank and completes the trading steps in the offer. Each user sees their own offer, so the amount, deadline and number of paid referrals can differ. It is available in selected countries only.
ref-kraken.whoItsFor: Kraken app users in supported countries who know people in the same country who want to start buying crypto.
howItPays: Kraken's referrals page advertises up to $75 for you and your friend each, with total referral payouts of up to $1,500, per Kraken's page, checked Nov 24, 2026; the help article for the app program describes a fixed $20 bonus with up to $1,000 total, so treat the figure in your own app as the one that applies.
Bonuses may be paid in crypto or cash, as set in your offer, and Kraken says they are not guaranteed.
Kraken says to allow about 14 days after your friend completes the steps for the bonus to arrive.
Depending on the offer, bonuses apply to 10, 15 or 20 referrals, and only one reward is allowed per device and per household.
eligibility: The friend must be new to Kraken and must sign up through your link in the Kraken mobile app.
The friend must deposit cash from a bank account; card deposits are excluded, and stablecoin trades do not count.
Your friend must live in the same country as you, except that eligible EEA countries count together.
Kraken's help article says Maine and New York are excluded in the US.
steps: 1. Open the Referrals area in the Kraken app to see your offer and personal link.
2. Share the link directly by text, email or a messaging app.
3. Your friend downloads the app, signs up through your link, and deposits from their bank.
4. Your friend completes the trading requirement before the deadline in the offer.
5. Track progress in the Referrals dashboard and wait for the bonus.
tips: Check your offer details before inviting, since deadlines differ; Kraken's pages mention windows of 15 and 30 days.
Remind your friend that card deposits and stablecoin trades will not count.
Keep invites to people you actually know in your own country.
watchOuts: Promoting your link through paid search, social media ads or sponsored posts deactivates it, and referrals through it earn nothing.
Duplicate accounts and devices are disqualified, and Kraken can change or end the program without notice.
Rewards can count as taxable income where you live, so keep a record of what you receive and check with a tax professional if you are unsure.
Crypto prices can swing sharply and you can lose money; a referral bonus is never a reason to buy or trade. This guide describes the program only and is not investment advice.

faq.q: Can my friend sign up on the website instead of the app?
faq.a: Kraken's help article says the friend must sign up via the Kraken app to be eligible.

faq.q: Can I refer someone in another country?
faq.a: Generally no. The friend must live in the same country as you, with an exception for eligible EEA countries.

faq.q: Can I post my link on social media?
faq.a: Kraken prohibits promoting it through social media ads, sponsored posts or paid search. It explicitly allows sharing by text, email and messaging apps.

ref-kraken.publicPostingNote: Kraken bans promoting invite links through paid search, social media ads or sponsored posts, and allows direct sharing.

sources.title: How the Kraken Referral Program Works

ref-binanceus.summary: Binance.US runs a simple give-and-get referral program: when a friend signs up with your link or code, verifies their account and buys or trades a set amount of crypto within a month, you each get a cash bonus. Binance.US relaunched the program on September 10, 2025, and can change or cancel it at any time.
ref-binanceus.whoItsFor: Individual Binance.US account holders who know people in the US who already plan to buy crypto.
howItPays: You and your friend each receive $10 in USD per qualifying referral, per Binance.US's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Your friend qualifies with $100 or more in crypto buys or spot trades within 30 days of account verification, measured in UTC, per Binance.US's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Binance.US's FAQ says payouts are given right after the friend meets the requirement, and the rewards are then subject to a 30-day withdrawal hold.
The USD reward can be used to buy crypto or withdrawn once the hold ends.
eligibility: The program is for individual account holders; institutional clients are excluded.
The friend must be new to Binance.US and must sign up using your link, code or QR code; codes cannot be added after sign-up.
The friend must complete Advanced Verification before the 30-day clock starts.
Buys on the Buy Crypto page and spot market trades count toward the $100.
steps: 1. Log in to Binance.US and open the referral page to get your referral ID, link and QR code.
2. Share it with someone who already plans to open a Binance.US account.
3. Your friend signs up with the link or code and completes Advanced Verification.
4. Your friend buys or trades at least $100 of crypto within 30 days.
5. Check the referral page for status and the reward.
tips: Make sure your friend enters the code at sign-up, because it cannot be added later.
Point out that the 30 days start at verification, measured in UTC, to avoid timing surprises.
Plan around the 30-day withdrawal hold if you intend to move the reward out.
watchOuts: Binance.US can disqualify participants for fraudulent, abusive or suspicious referral activity and for spam.
The program can be modified or cancelled at any time, so check the current terms before sharing.

Rewards can count as taxable income where you live, so keep a record of what you receive and check with a tax professional if you are unsure. Binance.US says the referrer is responsible for any tax owed on rewards.
Crypto prices can swing sharply and you can lose money; a referral bonus is never a reason to buy or trade. This guide describes the program only and is not investment advice.

faq.q: Is the reward paid in Bitcoin?
faq.a: No. Binance.US's FAQ says the reward is paid in USD, which you can use to buy crypto or withdraw.

faq.q: Can my friend add my code after creating an account?
faq.a: No. The FAQ says referral codes cannot be added after sign-up.

faq.q: Is there a limit on how many people I can refer?
faq.a: The current FAQ does not mention a cap, so check the referral page for any limits that apply to your account.

ref-binanceus.publicPostingNote: Binance.US pages bar spam and abusive referral activity but set no explicit rule on public posting of links.

ref-notion.summary: Notion's affiliate program pays creators and publishers when people they send open a new Notion workspace and move to a paid plan. Right now Notion's own affiliate page says the program is not taking new affiliates, so only partners who already have a PartnerStack account can earn from it. It fits writers, teachers and template makers who already show an audience how to work in Notion.
ref-notion.whoItsFor: Existing Notion affiliates, and creators who want to be ready if Notion reopens sign-ups. There is no simple refer-a-friend reward here.
howItPays: Closed to new applicants: Notion's affiliate page says the program is currently not accepting new affiliates (per Notion's page, checked Nov 24, 2026). Existing affiliates can still log in through PartnerStack.
Affiliates earn up to $50 for each activated sign-up plus 20% of the referral's first-year revenue, and the page says there is no cap on total earnings (per Notion's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

A referral only counts when it is a net new workspace that upgrades to a paid Plus or Business plan within 180 days of clicking your link, and credit goes to the last click before sign-up (per Notion's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

Notion can take back a reward, or subtract it from later commissions, if the customer drops from a paid monthly plan to free or gets a refund in the first two months (per Notion's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Links, stats and rewards live in PartnerStack; Notion's page lists no payout method or minimum.
eligibility: Notion aims the program at bloggers, educators, newsletters, content creators and template makers.
New applications are paused, so only affiliates already in the program can earn today.
The person you refer must create a new workspace, not upgrade one that already exists, and must choose a paid Plus or Business plan.
Referring yourself, or using the program to get a discount on your own account, is not allowed.
steps: Check notion.com/affiliates to see whether applications have reopened.
If they have, apply there; approved affiliates work inside PartnerStack.
Read the Participant Terms and Program Resource Guide linked from that page.
Place your PartnerStack link in content that shows real Notion setups, such as templates or walkthroughs.
Disclose the paid relationship next to the link, as Notion asks.
Track activated sign-ups and paid upgrades in PartnerStack.
tips: The 180-day window rewards evergreen material such as a template gallery or setup guide.
Recommend Plus or Business only to readers who need it; a quick downgrade or early refund can cancel your reward.
Since the last click wins, put your link where readers are ready to start, such as the end of a tutorial.
If you are not an affiliate yet, build a Notion-focused audience now so you have a track record if sign-ups reopen.
watchOuts: The program is closed to new affiliates, so any site promising quick approval is out of date.
Self-referrals and using your own link for a discount are banned.
Promoting without disclosing the paid relationship breaks Notion's rules and FTC guidance.

faq.q: Can I join the Notion affiliate program today?
faq.a: Not as a new applicant. Notion's affiliate page says it is not accepting new affiliates at the moment. People already in the program can keep using their PartnerStack accounts.

faq.q: Does a free Notion sign-up earn anything?
faq.a: The reward is tied to activated sign-ups and paid upgrades. The workspace has to be new and has to move to Plus or Business within 180 days of the click to qualify.

faq.q: How do Notion affiliates get paid?
faq.a: Through PartnerStack. The affiliate page gives no payout method or threshold, so check your PartnerStack account.

ref-notion.publicPostingNote: Existing affiliates promote in public content with a disclosure, but the program is closed to newcomers and the full Participant Terms page would not load for review.

ref-canva.summary: Canva's affiliate program has changed. Canva's affiliate information page now says affiliate benefits are only available through the Canvassador Program, its community of people who teach others to use Canva, and that program is closed to new applications for now. Canva's older affiliate landing page still advertises a commission on new Canva Pro subscribers, so the two pages currently send mixed signals.
ref-canva.whoItsFor: Design teachers and creators who already publish Canva tutorials, courses or workshops and want to apply when the Canvassador Program reopens. Existing affiliates also need to reapply to keep earning.
howItPays: Changed and currently closed: Canva's affiliate page says affiliate benefits now come only through the Canvassador Program, which is closed for applications (per Canva's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

Canva's older affiliate landing page still lists up to $36 for each new Canva Pro subscriber who joins through your link (per Canva's page, checked Nov 24, 2026). Expect the Canvassador terms you accept at onboarding to govern what is actually paid.
Tracking credits a sign-up that happens within 30 days of the visitor's first click (per Canva's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
The landing page says affiliates can be paid by PayPal or e-transfer (per Canva's page, checked Nov 24, 2026). No minimum balance or fixed schedule is published.
Affiliates who are accepted as Canvassadors keep their Impact Radius ID and existing links and agree to new terms in an onboarding deck (per Canva's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
eligibility: Individual content creators must be accepted into the Canvassador Program before they can receive affiliate benefits.
Current affiliates have to reapply and be accepted as Canvassadors to keep their benefits.
The older landing page aimed at design bloggers, online design teachers and design-related sites with more than one million monthly visits.
Canva's pages do not say how businesses or large publishers fit the new setup.
steps: Read Canva's affiliate information page to see whether the Canvassador Program is open again.
Build a visible record of Canva teaching work, such as tutorials, template walkthroughs, courses or live workshops.
When applications open, apply through the Canva Community page, which carries the application forms in several languages.
If you are accepted, read the new affiliate terms in the onboarding materials before posting any links.
Use your Impact tracking links and disclose the relationship.
tips: Center your content on teaching; Canva describes the Canvassador Program as a group of people who help others learn the tool.
If you were an affiliate before, reapply instead of assuming your old links will keep paying.
Save a copy of the terms you accept, since Canva's public pages do not match.
Do not promise readers a Pro discount unless Canva gives you one to share.
watchOuts: Canva's two affiliate pages disagree; the newer one says the program is closed, so do not rely on the older landing page by itself.
Links from an affiliate account that is not moved into the Canvassador Program may stop earning.
The affiliate rules are shared during onboarding rather than on a public page, so limits on paid ads or coupon sites could not be checked.

faq.q: Can I become a Canva affiliate today?
faq.a: Not directly. Canva says affiliate benefits now come through the Canvassador Program, and that program is closed to applications right now.

faq.q: What happens to my existing Canva affiliate links?
faq.a: Canva says current affiliates must reapply to the Canvassador Program. If accepted, their Impact Radius ID and existing links stay valid under the new terms.

faq.q: How much does Canva pay affiliates?
faq.a: The older affiliate landing page lists up to $36 per new Canva Pro subscriber with a 30-day tracking window. The Canvassador terms, shared after acceptance, may differ.

ref-canva.publicPostingNote: Canva shares Canvassador affiliate terms only at onboarding, so public posting rules could not be confirmed.

ref-hostinger.summary: Hostinger's affiliate program pays a share of the first purchase when someone you send buys a qualifying hosting, website builder or related plan. It is meant for people with an audience interested in websites, IT or online business, and it runs on Hostinger's own affiliate platform. Hostinger points people without an audience to a separate customer referral program.
ref-hostinger.whoItsFor: Bloggers, YouTubers and social creators who cover web hosting, IT or online business. Web agencies and people without an audience are directed to Hostinger's Referral Program instead.
howItPays: Commission starts at 40% per eligible sale and can rise with sales volume (per Hostinger's page, checked Nov 24, 2026). AI Builder offers can reach 60%, and Revenue Share offers are capped at $300 per sale.

Most products only pay on the first purchase of a 12-month or longer plan; one-month hosting plans, renewals, upgrades, taxes, fees and add-ons earn nothing (per Hostinger's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Cookies last up to 30 days, and a newer affiliate's cookie replaces yours in the same browser (per Hostinger's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Only commissions older than 45 days are paid out. You need $100 and three approved conversions for PayPal, or $500 and three for bank transfer (per Hostinger's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
You request payment by email before the month ends; invoices are made at the start of the next month and money is released after the 15th (per Hostinger's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
eligibility: Joining is free, and each application is reviewed by hand, which Hostinger says can take up to five business days.
Hostinger looks for a blog, social page or YouTube channel about IT or online business with at least 1,000 traffic, or for B2B partners.
The buyer must be new to Hostinger; sales to existing customers do not pay.
Affiliates in the EU may need to register for VAT and are responsible for their own tax filings.
steps: Read Hostinger's affiliate FAQ and Affiliate Program Agreement.
Sign up on the affiliate platform and complete the verification step.
Wait for the manual review, then take your link and banners from the dashboard.
Publish honest tutorials or comparisons with your link and a disclosure.
Email a payment request with your affiliate ID before the end of the month.
tips: Focus on yearly or longer plans in your content, since one-month hosting plans do not pay.
Be upfront about the 30-day money-back window; cancellations in that period reverse the commission.
Get written approval before using any coupon, discount or cashback angle.
If you have no audience, use Hostinger's customer Referral Program instead of applying here.
watchOuts: Self-referral is banned, and Hostinger treats a matching login and purchase IP address, or a VPN at checkout, as signs of it.
Pay-per-click campaigns, trademark bidding without approval and using hostinger.com as the display URL in ads are not allowed.
Rule breaks can forfeit unpaid commissions and bring a $125 administrative fee, and Hostinger may hold a balance for up to 180 days while it reviews activity.
Accounts with no new conversions for six months are marked dormant, and commissions left unwithdrawn for two years are removed.

faq.q: Do Hostinger renewals earn commission?
faq.a: No. Hostinger pays on the first qualifying purchase only. Renewals, upgrades and one-month hosting plans are excluded.

faq.q: When can I get paid?
faq.a: After three approved conversions and the minimum balance for your method, on commissions older than 45 days. Request by email; money goes out after the 15th of the next month.

faq.q: Can I share Hostinger coupon codes?
faq.a: Only with prior approval for coupon or discount offers, and you may not use codes that were issued to other affiliates.

ref-hostinger.publicPostingNote: Links in your own content are fine, but paid ads, unapproved coupons or cashback, unauthorized forum link placement and unsolicited email are not allowed.

ref-namecheap.summary: Namecheap's affiliate program pays a percentage of a new customer's first order for domains, hosting, SSL certificates, email and a few other products. It is run through affiliate networks rather than in-house: you join on Impact or on CJ (Commission Junction), and Namecheap suggests using just one. It works well for domain tools, web design blogs and developer audiences.
ref-namecheap.whoItsFor: Publishers whose readers buy domains or hosting, such as domain name generators, web design blogs and coding tutorials. Namecheap says anyone can join if they follow the program terms.
howItPays: Network-based: Namecheap's affiliate page says the program is now powered by Impact, with CJ offered as a second option (per Namecheap's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

Listed rates include 20% on domain registrations and transfers, 35% on hosting packages and SSL certificates, and 20% on Private Email and PremiumDNS, paid on a new customer's first order (per Namecheap's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

VPN and RelateSocial have their own percentage schedules, and coupon, cashback, loyalty and sub-affiliate sites may receive lower rates than the listed ones (per Namecheap's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
The tracking cookie stays valid for 30 days (per Namecheap's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

On Impact, payouts go by EFT or PayPal with a minimum equal to $10; on CJ they go by direct deposit, paper check or Payoneer with a 50 USD (or 25 EUR or GBP) minimum (per Namecheap's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
eligibility: Open to anyone approved on Impact or CJ who follows the Affiliate Program Terms of Service.
Only orders from new customers count, so buying for yourself earns nothing.
Apps other than RelateSocial and FastVPN, marketplace items, premium domains and hosting add-ons are not commissionable.
Impact requires a tax form (W-9, W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E) before it releases any payment.
steps: Choose Impact or CJ; if you already use one of them, Namecheap recommends staying there.
Apply to the Namecheap program on that network and wait for approval.
Create links: the standard link, landing page links, domain search result links, banners, program coupons or the Domain Search Widget.
Place them on your site with a clear affiliate disclosure.
Add your tax form and payment details in the network dashboard.
Use network reports to see what converts.
tips: Link straight to domain search results or a specific product page rather than the home page.
Use only coupons supplied through the affiliate program; other codes can stop the order from crediting.
Tracking depends on the 30-day cookie, so it helps when readers buy in the same browser they clicked from.
If an order seems to be missing, email Namecheap's affiliate team with the order ID and your affiliate ID.
watchOuts: Self-purchases and orders from existing customers do not pay.
Custom banners using the Namecheap logo are not allowed.
Coupon and cashback sites may earn less than the headline rates.
Premium domains and hosting add-ons are excluded, so a large order can pay less than you expect.

faq.q: Can I join Namecheap's affiliate program directly on namecheap.com?
faq.a: No. You join through Impact or CJ, and Namecheap suggests picking one.

faq.q: Do domain renewals pay commission?
faq.a: The standard rates apply to a new customer's first order, so ordinary renewals are not covered. VPN and RelateSocial follow their own renewal-based schedules.

faq.q: What is the minimum payout?
faq.a: On Impact it is the equivalent of $10, paid by EFT or PayPal. On CJ it is 50 USD or 25 EUR or GBP, paid by direct deposit, check or Payoneer.

ref-namecheap.publicPostingNote: Publishing links on your own site is the intended use; only program-supplied coupons count, and coupon or cashback sites may get lower rates.

ref-digitalocean.summary: DigitalOcean's referral program gives a team account credit when someone it invites signs up and turns into a paying user. It trades credit for credit rather than paying cash, which makes it a good fit for developers who already run projects on DigitalOcean and recommend it to coworkers. Publishers who want cash commissions can look at DigitalOcean's separate affiliate program.
ref-digitalocean.whoItsFor: Developers, students and small teams already on DigitalOcean who want to trim their own cloud bill. People who publish tutorials and want cash should compare the affiliate program.
howItPays: Your team gets $25 in credit after the person you refer spends and pays for $25 of usage (per DigitalOcean's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
The person you refer receives DigitalOcean's standard signup credit, which its docs list as $5 that expires 90 days after signup (per DigitalOcean's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
There is no limit on how much referral credit you can earn, and you can send up to 30 invitations a day (per DigitalOcean's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Referral credit cannot be cashed out or moved to another team; credit still waiting on the $25 threshold shows as pending in your referral stats.
For cash instead of credit, DigitalOcean's affiliate page offers 10% commission each month for a year on a referred user's spend (per DigitalOcean's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
eligibility: You need a DigitalOcean team; each team has its own referral link.
Teams that belong to an organization cannot use the referral program.
The friend has to sign up through your link and then spend and pay for $25 of usage before your credit is released.
Promotional credit is void on accounts created only to collect credits, and in cases of fraud or misuse.
steps: Sign in to the DigitalOcean Control Panel and open the Referrals tab under Settings.
Copy your link from the Share your unique URL section, or use the Share via X button.
Optionally embed a referral badge using the HTML or Markdown code provided.
Invite coworkers or friends, up to 30 per day.
Watch the referral stats for pending and earned credit.
Let the credit apply to your bill once a referral passes the paid-usage mark.
tips: The badge fits naturally on open-source READMEs and project docs where readers are already deploying code.
The standard signup credit is small, so explain why you use the platform rather than leaning on the credit.
Let friends know your reward only arrives after they have paid for $25 of usage, so nobody feels misled.
If you write tutorials regularly, compare the cash affiliate program before relying on credit alone.
watchOuts: Referral credit has no cash value and cannot be moved to another team.
Accounts opened just to collect credit void that credit, and DigitalOcean can ask you to repay credit used in breach of its terms.
Organization-owned teams are excluded from the referral program.
Signup credit expires, so a friend who signs up and waits too long may lose the starter credit.

faq.q: Is the DigitalOcean referral reward paid in cash?
faq.a: No. It is $25 of account credit for your team, and it cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

faq.q: When does my referral credit show up?
faq.a: After the person you referred spends and pays for $25 of usage. Until then it appears as pending in your referral stats.

faq.q: What does the person I refer receive?
faq.a: The standard signup credit, which DigitalOcean's documentation currently lists as $5 expiring 90 days after signup. Promotions change, so check the signup credit docs for the current amount.

ref-digitalocean.publicPostingNote: DigitalOcean supplies shareable badges and an X share button, and its referral docs contain no ban on public posting.

sources.title: Refer friends & colleagues, earn free credits
How To Participate in DigitalOcean's Referral Program

ref-grammarly.summary: Grammarly's affiliate program pays a small flat amount when someone you send opens a free account and a larger flat amount when they upgrade to a paid plan. The join links on Grammarly's affiliate page lead to Impact, and the program suits writing, education and productivity sites. Grammarly keeps a separate customer referral program with different rules.
ref-grammarly.whoItsFor: Bloggers, teachers, writing coaches and productivity creators whose readers write often. Fans who want community perks rather than commission can look at the Grammarly Collective ambassador group instead.
howItPays: $0.20 for each free account sign-up and $20 for each upgrade to Grammarly Pro (per Grammarly's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

Sign-ups and purchases count if they happen within 90 days of the user's first visit through your link, and the last click before conversion gets the credit (per Grammarly's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

The operating agreement says new affiliates are paid within 25 days after the end of the month the commission was earned (per Grammarly's page, checked Nov 24, 2026); the clause also says twenty in words, so confirm the timing in your dashboard.

Grammarly's affiliate page offers an activation bonus to new affiliates who place a banner and write a post, and a 90-day cookie window (per Grammarly's page, checked Nov 24, 2026). The bonus amount is not stated in the page text.
A separate Business track pays on team purchases and large-seat leads; those amounts are not published.
eligibility: No audience minimum is listed, and Grammarly says signing up takes under a minute.
A free sign-up only counts when the email address is not already in Grammarly's database.
You must be opted into the Individual Consumer program to earn on consumer sign-ups and upgrades.
Promoting through gig sites such as Craigslist, Picoworkers or Microworkers is not allowed, and Grammarly says there are no exceptions.
steps: Read the Affiliate Program Operating Agreement linked from grammarly.com/affiliates.
Join through the sign-up link on the affiliate page, which takes you to Impact.
Get your tracking link and banners, then place a banner and publish a post to qualify for the activation bonus.
Show Grammarly in real use, such as editing an email, with your link and a disclosure.
Add valid payment details so commissions are not voided.
Dispute any invoice within 30 days.
tips: Free sign-ups pay very little, so content that helps readers judge whether Pro is worth it tends to matter more.
Stay out of paid search unless you have written permission; even generic terms such as grammar checker are on the banned list.
Use only codes and deals that come through Grammarly's official affiliate portals.
Keep the account active; Grammarly may close accounts with no activity for 12 months.
watchOuts: Bidding on Grammarly trademarks or listed non-brand keywords such as grammar checker and plagiarism checker is prohibited.
Incentivized traffic, phone sales, network-to-network brokering and ads on auction sites are banned, and a breach means removal with a permanent bar.
Failing to supply valid payment details can void all of your commissions.
Creating leads just to inflate commissions is prohibited.

faq.q: How much does Grammarly pay per referral?
faq.a: Grammarly's support page lists $0.20 for a free account sign-up and $20 for an upgrade to Grammarly Pro.

faq.q: How long does tracking last?
faq.a: A sign-up or purchase counts if it happens within 90 days of the user's first visit through your link, and the final click before conversion gets the credit.

faq.q: Is this the same as Grammarly's refer-a-friend program?

Websites, YouTube channels and social accounts can all take part, and the same account opens doors to affiliate offers for other Nord Security products. It suits tech, privacy and travel creators.
ref-nordvpn.whoItsFor: Creators and publishers who cover online privacy, security or travel. A website is not required; NordVPN accepts traffic from YouTube and social media.
howItPays: 100% of the first payment on the 1-month offer, 40% on the 1-year and 2-year offers, and 30% on renewals of every plan (per NordVPN's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
A sale is still credited if it happens within 30 days of the customer's visit through your link (per NordVPN's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Commission is sent once your balance passes $100, by PayPal or direct wire transfer, after you request it by email (per NordVPN's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Payments run 40 days behind because of the 30-day money-back guarantee (per NordVPN's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Affiliates also get access to affiliate offers for other Nord Security products, including NordPass, NordLayer and Saily.
eligibility: No website or blog is required; YouTube and social channels count.
Content may not promote piracy, circumvention, unblocking or access to age-restricted material by minors.
Mentions of other VPNs must be objective, truthful and not misleading.
NordVPN's pages do not describe an approval process or country limits; tracking links come from the affiliate dashboard.

Sign up and log in to the affiliate dashboard.
Copy your unique tracking URL and any approved creative assets.
Plan content that explains what NordVPN does and covers at least two real benefits, as the guide suggests.
Send unpublished content for approval at least two business days before it goes live, per the guide.
Email a payment request once your balance passes the minimum.

On Facebook, share your website address rather than the direct affiliate link.

The 40-day payment delay means your first payout comes slowly.

faq.a: No. NordVPN says traffic from a YouTube channel or social media accounts is acceptable.

faq.q: Is this the same as NordVPN's refer-a-friend program?

It is managed through Impact and is a natural fit for WordPress, blogging and small-business sites. You do not have to be a Bluehost customer to apply.
ref-bluehost.whoItsFor: Bloggers and site owners who teach people how to start a website, especially with WordPress. Applicants need a working site with real content and some traffic.
howItPays: Commissions start at $65 per qualified sale, and Bluehost says some hosting plans also carry recurring commissions (per Bluehost's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Purchases made within 30 days of a referred click are credited to you (per Bluehost's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

The affiliate page says commissions are processed within 45 to 70 days after a sale, and the help article puts it at about 45 days after the end of the month the credit was recorded (per Bluehost's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Payment is by PayPal or electronic funds transfer, with a 2% processing fee capped at $20 (per Bluehost's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
The exact qualifying rules sit in the insertion order in your Impact account; Bluehost's public pages do not state a minimum payout.
eligibility: Anyone with a blog or website can apply, and you do not need to be a Bluehost customer.
Applications need a working URL, suitable content and some traffic; Bluehost says it reviews them in about 48 hours.
US partners submit a W-9, and non-US affiliates working with a US brand submit a W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E.
Commission applies to qualified customers who buy a 12-month or 36-month hosting package.
steps: Read the affiliate page and the affiliate help FAQ on bluehost.com.
Create an Impact account and apply to the Bluehost Partner Program.
Watch for the approval email and dashboard notice.
Set up payouts under Balance, then Bank Account (two-factor authentication is required), and submit your tax form.
Publish tutorials or reviews with your tracking link and a disclosure.
Check Impact reports for validated and reversed actions.
tips: Step-by-step guides on starting a blog or site match the 12-month and 36-month plans that qualify.
Stick to coupons Bluehost has approved.
Get approval before running any search engine ads.
Be honest about renewal pricing so referrals are less likely to cancel; a high cancellation rate can lead Bluehost to withhold commissions.
watchOuts: Unapproved coupon codes, misleading ads and search marketing campaigns run without approval can get you removed.
Bluehost may hold back or reject commissions on accounts that look fraudulent or have many cancellations.
Actions that are reversed are not paid.
Payment arrives roughly six weeks or more after the month closes, so plan for a lag.

faq.q: How much does Bluehost pay affiliates?
faq.a: Bluehost's affiliate page says commissions start at $65 per qualified sale, and some plans also pay recurring commissions.

faq.a: Impact. Bluehost's help article says you create a Bluehost Partner Program profile there, and payouts and tax forms are handled in that account.

ref-siteground.summary: SiteGround's affiliate program pays a flat amount for each hosting sale, with the amount rising as your monthly sales grow, plus a percentage on several other services. Payouts are weekly with no default minimum, which helps smaller sites see money sooner. It suits bloggers, developers and creators who recommend web hosting.
ref-siteground.whoItsFor: Bloggers, developers, content creators and business owners who recommend hosting. A website is not required, but you need some way to send people to your link.
howItPays: Hosting sales pay $50 each at 1 to 5 sales a month, $75 at 6 to 10, up to $100 at 11 to 20, and a custom deal from 21 sales up (per SiteGround's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Website Builder, Ecommerce, Coderick AI and Email Marketing purchases pay 60% of first-year revenue and do not count toward the hosting tiers (per SiteGround's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Referrals have 60 days after the first click to convert (per SiteGround's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

Commissions are paid every Wednesday once a sale clears a 30 to 40 day review, which stretches to 90 days for one-month billing cycles, and there is no default minimum (per SiteGround's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Standard payouts go to PayPal; high-volume affiliates can ask for wire transfer, which has a default minimum of 5000 in your currency (per SiteGround's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
eligibility: Joining is free and you can quit at any time.
Shared, Cloud and Reseller hosting earn commission; domain names and extra features do not.
Longer billing cycles must total at least 40 USD, EUR or AUD, or 30 GBP, to count; one-month sales do qualify.
The referred hosting plan must still be active and paid up when the payout is made.
steps: Sign up at siteground.com/affiliates with your contact details and how you plan to refer customers.
Add a valid PayPal account under Payout Details.
Collect your link and current banners from the Affiliate Area.
Publish reviews or tutorials that point to the predefined offer your link uses.
Follow pending and paid commissions under Payout History.
tips: Promote SiteGround's site-wide sales and current banners; it does not issue custom coupon codes.
Because rates rise with monthly volume, publishing related tutorials close together can help you reach a higher tier.
Mention only the offer your link points to, since other services may not be tracked.
YouTubers, podcasters and influencers with steady volume can ask about a custom partnership.
watchOuts: Buying a plan through your own link is allowed but earns no commission.
Bidding on the SiteGround trademark or close variations in PPC or pay-per-impression ads needs prior approval.
Sales on one-month billing face a longer 90-day review.
If the referred account is cancelled or unpaid at payout time, the commission is lost.

faq.a: Not by default for PayPal. SiteGround pays weekly even for one sale unless you set your own minimum. Wire transfers carry a high default minimum.

faq.q: Can I get a custom coupon for my readers?
faq.a: No. SiteGround says its order system cannot handle custom coupons, but you are free to promote its site-wide promotions.

faq.q: Do domain names earn commission?
faq.a: No. Shared, Cloud and Reseller hosting count toward the hosting tiers, and a short list of other services pays a first-year percentage.

It runs on Impact and uses tiers based on how many sign-ups you drive each month. It suits software reviewers, marketing teachers and companies whose products connect to HubSpot.
ref-hubspot.whoItsFor: Software reviewers, content creators, online educators and businesses with HubSpot integrations. Agencies referring their own clients belong in HubSpot's Solutions Partner Program instead.
howItPays: 30% monthly recurring commission for up to one year (per HubSpot's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
A 180-day cookie window (per HubSpot's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Payouts are processed through Impact by direct deposit (EFT) or PayPal once your balance reaches at least $10 USD (per HubSpot's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).

Tiers follow monthly sign-ups: Starter (0 to 29), Sprocket (30 to 99) and Elite (100 or more); Elite custom rates need affiliate team approval, and moving up requires three steady months (per HubSpot's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
A transaction is forfeited if your tax documents or payment method are still missing six months after it closes (per HubSpot's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
eligibility: HubSpot reviews applications in two to three business days, and you do not need to be a HubSpot customer.
There is no minimum number of sales required to earn.
Client referrals from agencies go through the Solutions Partner Program, not this one.
Buying HubSpot for yourself through your own affiliate link is not allowed.
steps: Read the Affiliate Program Agreement (last modified February 23, 2026) and the Program Policies.
Apply from hubspot.com/partners/affiliates.
After approval, finish your Impact account with tax forms and a payment method.
Create content such as CRM comparisons or setup guides using your Impact links.
State that you are part of the affiliate program on every page that carries a link.
Track sign-ups in Impact and aim for consistent months if you want to move up a tier.
tips: The 180-day window suits in-depth guides that readers come back to before buying.
Finish tax and payment setup early so no commission is forfeited.
Keep comparisons fair; deceptive claims and misleading links are banned.
Do not offer readers rewards for signing up, since sign-up incentives are prohibited.
watchOuts: Bidding on HubSpot branded keywords, or running ads that compete with HubSpot's own, is prohibited.
Cookie stuffing, pop-ups, hidden frames, purchased lead lists and masked referrers are banned.
Purchasing through your own link is not allowed.
HubSpot can offset money you owe it against payouts, and either side can end the agreement on 15 days' written notice.

faq.a: HubSpot's affiliate page lists a 30% monthly recurring commission for up to one year per customer.

faq.a: You can withdraw through Impact once you have at least $10 USD, by EFT or PayPal.

faq.q: Can my agency use this program for client deals?

ref-kit.whoItsFor: Creators, SaaS reviewers, publishers, course creators and app builders. You do not have to be a Kit customer, and Kit lists no minimum audience size.
howItPays: 50% commission on each new customer's first 12 months (per Kit's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Refer 10 or more paying customers in a year and you add a 10% recurring commission on those customers for as long as they stay (per Kit's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
The referral link uses a 90-day cookie, and the person must sign up for a paid Kit plan within that window (per Kit's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Commissions are held 31 days to cover refunds, and you can withdraw once you reach $5, usually around the 13th of the month (per Kit's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Payouts go through PartnerStack by Stripe, PayPal or direct deposit, depending on your region (per Kit's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
eligibility: Joining is free, and Kit reviews each application, usually within two to three business days.
You must accept the Kit Affiliate Program Terms of Service when you apply.
Only referrals who move to a paid plan produce commission.
