Apply through PartnerStack from kit.com/affiliate, and do not reapply while your application is pending.
Once approved, take your links, banners and logos from the PartnerStack dashboard.
Share your link in newsletters, podcasts, social posts or tutorials, with a disclosure.
Set up withdrawals in PartnerStack.
Follow clicks, sign-ups and payouts in the dashboard.
tips: Show your own Kit setup; real walkthroughs are more convincing and easier to keep honest.
The 90-day cookie means evergreen tutorials keep working long after they go up.
Aim for ten paying referrals within a year to unlock the recurring share.
If you email through Kit, keep affiliate links a small part of content about your own work.
watchOuts: A refund during the 31-day hold removes the commission.
Kit's help center describes the recurring tier as 10 to 20% depending on status level, while the main page says 10%; go by your PartnerStack dashboard.
Kit's public pages do not spell out rules on paid ads or coupon sites, so read the affiliate Terms of Service before running ads.
Some older help articles still describe a previous payout setup, so treat the main affiliate page and PartnerStack as current.

Surfshark pays within 30 days after a purchase clears its 30-day money-back period (per Surfshark's page, checked Nov 24, 2026).
Eligible products include the VPN, Antivirus, Alert and Incogni. Payment methods are not listed publicly, and payment costs fall on the affiliate.
eligibility: No website is needed; promotion on Facebook, X and YouTube is accepted, in any language.
A qualified action needs a paid subscription that is not cancelled within the allowed period.
Using the VPN yourself does not earn commission.
Surfshark can end anyone's participation at any time.

Sign up through Surfshark's affiliate page, or look for Surfshark on a network you already use.
Get your tracking links and any official coupons from the affiliate platform.
Publish reviews, setup guides or videos with your link and a disclosure.
Once your balance is over $100, request payment, or invoice monthly if your revenue is steady.
tips: Use only coupons and discounts provided through the affiliate program.
Since the last click wins, put links where readers make their decision.
Check each invoice and raise disputes within 30 days.
Ask about CPA terms once your traffic is steady.

Offering users cash back or other rewards needs Surfshark's written consent.
Unsolicited marketing email is not allowed.
Refunds and chargebacks cancel commissions and can be taken from later payments, and six months of inactivity can lead to withheld commissions.

faq.a: Within 30 days after a purchase clears the 30-day money-back period, and only once your balance is over $100.

ref-expressvpn.summary: ExpressVPN's affiliate program pays publishers a one-time commission when a reader they send buys a VPN subscription. ExpressVPN does not publish its rates; each affiliate's commission model is set in an individual insertion order after approval.
ref-expressvpn.whoItsFor: Owners of live websites, YouTube channels or newsletters with genuine VPN-related content and a clear plan for sending traffic. Coupon sites and reseller programs are usually turned away.
howItPays: Commission is a one-time fee per completed, non-refunded sale (CPA), not a share of renewals; your exact rate is set in an insertion order rather than published, per ExpressVPN's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Payments go out monthly on a Net 30 basis, about 30 days after the end of the month the sales happened, minus customer refunds, per ExpressVPN's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

PayPal is the standard payment method, and direct wire transfer is available once monthly commissions exceed $1,000, per ExpressVPN's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Attribution is last click: if a buyer clicked several affiliate links, the most recent one gets the credit.
eligibility: You must apply and be approved; ExpressVPN says applications are usually reviewed within one to two business days.
Your site or profile must be live, owned by you and carry VPN-relevant content with reasonable quality and traffic.
Coupon sites, reseller programs, cookie stuffing and spam-driven traffic are listed as common reasons for rejection.
You need accurate, verifiable account details, one account per affiliate unless approved otherwise, and the legal capacity to enter a contract.

tips: Ask the affiliate team for a test subscription so your review reflects hands-on use.
Write about specific situations, such as public Wi-Fi or router setup, instead of generic lists, and disclose the affiliate link nearby.

watchOuts: Bidding on ExpressVPN brand terms or misspellings, using affiliate links in paid search ads and masking domains are not allowed.
Promotion by SMS, WhatsApp or other messaging apps, unsolicited email, comment or forum spam, pop-ups and unapproved incentives can void commissions or get you removed.
Accounts with no referral fees or no logins for 12 months may be closed.
Either side can end the agreement at any time, and you must take down links and materials when it ends.

faq.q: Does ExpressVPN publish its commission rate?
faq.a: No. The public pages describe the structure, but the actual rate comes from the insertion order you agree to after approval.

faq.q: Are commissions recurring?
faq.a: No. ExpressVPN describes its commissions as CPA-based, meaning a single payment per qualifying sale rather than a cut of renewals.

faq.q: Can I promote ExpressVPN on a coupon site?
faq.a: It is a poor fit. ExpressVPN lists partnering with coupon sites as a reason it declines applications.

howItPays: Changed: Udemy's help center says Impact is the only network where new publishers can apply for the program, while the main affiliate page still refers to LinkShare; no closure notice appears, per Udemy's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The baseline commission is 10% of valid affiliate sales, with possible performance-based or temporary increases that Udemy offers directly, per Udemy's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The tracking cookie lasts 7 days and covers any course bought in that window, not only the one you linked, as long as your cookie was the last one set, per Udemy's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Commissions are paid only after the 30-day customer refund window clears, so April sales are invoiced in May and paid in June, per Udemy's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Payouts come from the network; Udemy's Impact help section says you need at least $10 in your balance before withdrawing, per Udemy's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: Your site or page must already be live; brand-new or not-yet-launched sites are declined.

Purchases by new and existing Udemy users both count, but free courses, free-coupon purchases, unapproved codes and subscription purchases do not.
US-based affiliates must have a tax form approved in Impact before payouts are released.

Review courses you have actually taken and say who each one suits.

A refund inside the refund window cancels the commission.

faq.q: Can I run ads to my Udemy links?

Payouts are monthly, sent 30 days after the end of the month in which a commission locks, through the payment method you set in Impact, per Skillshare's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Only new paying members earn commission, and refunded memberships do not count.

Remind readers that the referral only counts if it turns into a paid membership within the attribution window.
Disclose the affiliate link plainly.

Readers who already have paid accounts, or who refund, will not earn you commission.
Rates have changed before; recheck the affiliate page before quoting figures to your audience.
If you use the student referral program instead, its terms ban posting your link on message boards or forums, plus spam, bots, sponsored links and incentives.

faq.q: Did Skillshare's affiliate commission change?
faq.a: Yes. The current affiliate page lists a lower percentage and a lower cap than the figures in Skillshare's 2023 blog post. Treat the affiliate page as the current source.

faq.q: Is the student referral program the same thing?
faq.a: No. The student program pays an existing member in membership credit, while the affiliate program pays cash commissions through Impact and requires approval.

faq.q: Do I need a large following?
faq.a: Skillshare's affiliate page asks for at least one demonstrated channel that fits its brand. It does not list a follower minimum.

ref-skillshare.publicPostingNote: Affiliates may share links on their approved channels; the separate student referral program bans forums, message boards, spam and incentives.

Skillshare Student Referral Program Terms and Conditions

ref-airbnb.summary: Airbnb's guest invite program, which used to give travel credit for inviting friends, has closed: Airbnb's referrals page says no new invites can be sent. What remains is a host referral program that pays cash when someone you refer becomes a new host and gets a qualifying first booking. It suits members who know someone ready to list a home, experience or service.
ref-airbnb.whoItsFor: Airbnb members, especially hosts, who know someone new to hosting. It no longer helps travelers earn booking credit.
howItPays: Closed for guests: Airbnb's referrals page says the guest referral program is no longer open and no travel credit is given for referrals made after October 1, 2020; coupons and sender credits already issued stay valid until they expire, per Airbnb's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Host referrals pay a cash reward that varies by listing location and type; the amount for your country appears on your referral page, per Airbnb's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

The new host's first booking must happen within 180 days of starting the listing through your link and be worth at least $100 for homes or $50 for experiences and services, before taxes and fees, per Airbnb's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The reward is sent about 14 days after that first qualifying booking is completed and can take another 1 to 7 days to arrive, depending on payout method, per Airbnb's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

You can be paid for up to 25 referred hosts in each category (homes, experiences, services), and home referrals can unlock extra milestone bonuses after the 2nd, 3rd and 5th success, per Airbnb's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: The person you refer must be new to hosting and never have published a listing; current and former hosts do not qualify.
Shared rooms, private rooms, hotel rooms, relisted deactivated listings and most listings managed through API-connected software are generally ineligible.
The referral must be in an eligible location; Airbnb keeps a separate list of where the program runs.
Self-referrals, bookings by the new host's family or friends, and listings at your own address do not count.
steps: 1. Sign in to Airbnb and open Refer a Host from the referrals page or your account menu.
2. Check the reward shown for your country and listing type.
3. Send your personal link to someone you know who is ready to host.
4. Have them start and publish their listing through your link while signed in.
5. Follow their progress and wait for the first qualifying booking to finish; the reward goes to your payout method.
tips: Refer only people who are serious about hosting; a listing that is not booked within the window earns nothing.
Help the new host with clear photos and realistic pricing so the first booking comes sooner.
Airbnb sometimes runs time-limited host referral promotions with their own terms in its help center, so check before you share.
watchOuts: Links should go only to personal connections; public posting on commercial websites or social media is not allowed unless Airbnb says otherwise.
Paying to advertise your link and mass messaging people you do not know are prohibited.
Taxes on rewards are your responsibility, and Airbnb can withhold payment if it suspects fraud.

faq.q: Can I still invite friends to get travel credit?
faq.a: No. Airbnb says the guest referral program has closed and it no longer offers travel credit for referrals.

faq.q: What if my friend already has a listing?
faq.a: They do not qualify. The program is only for people who have never published a listing on Airbnb.

faq.q: Does it count if a friend books the new listing?
faq.a: No. Bookings by the referred host's family or friends are excluded.

ref-airbnb.publicPostingNote: Host referral terms limit links to personal connections and bar public posting on commercial sites or social media, paid ads and spam.

sources.title: Host Referral Offer and Program Terms

ref-rakuten.summary: Rakuten's Refer-A-Friend program gives you a cash bonus when someone you invite joins Rakuten and spends enough at Cash Back stores within their first 90 days. The new member usually gets a welcome bonus as well. It suits existing Rakuten members whose friends and family already shop online.
ref-rakuten.whoItsFor: Active Rakuten members in the US who can personally recommend the service to people who shop online often enough to reach the purchase threshold.
howItPays: The current US offer pays the referrer $50 for each qualified referral who signs up between October 1 and December 31, 2026, with no stated limit on the number of bonuses, per Rakuten's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

The friend qualifies by making Cash Back purchases totaling $50 within 90 days of joining, and the page describes a $50 bonus for the friend after that spend, per Rakuten's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Your bonus generally arrives within 60 days of the friend's qualifying purchase and is added to your next Cash Back payment, per Rakuten's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Amounts and thresholds change with each promotion; your friend gets whichever bonus was offered on the day they signed up.
Members with at least ten qualified referrals in one calendar quarter can be designated Influencers, with benefits at Rakuten's discretion, per Rakuten's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: The current offer requires both people to live in or be located in the 50 US states or DC; Rakuten's terms and FAQ also cover members in Canada.
The friend must be a new Rakuten member and an individual person, joining through your link or by entering your account email at sign-up.
Qualifying purchases must earn Cash Back through Rakuten's site, app or browser extension; Amazon.com purchases do not count, except music.amazon.com.
The friend must pay for the purchase; cancelled, returned or exchanged orders do not count.
steps: 1. Sign in to Rakuten and open the Refer-A-Friend page to copy your unique link.
2. Share it by email, text or a personal message with people you know.
3. Make sure your friend joins through the link or gives your email when signing up.
4. Track progress under My Referral Activity, where each invite shows Pending, Earned, Expired or Paid.
5. Look for the bonus on your next Cash Back payment.
tips: Time your invite around a purchase your friend already plans, such as holiday shopping, and remind them Amazon.com orders will not count.
Tell them store confirmation can take several weeks, so a pending status is normal for a while.
Check the referral page before sharing, since the bonus changes between promotions.
watchOuts: Rakuten's terms bar posting your referral link on any page you do not own and control, including merchant pages, Facebook pages and forums.
Paid advertising aimed at your referral link, bidding on keywords containing Rakuten or Ebates, and using Rakuten logos in ads are prohibited.
Self-referrals, fake accounts, bulk email and buying through someone else's account can cancel bonuses or close accounts.
Rakuten can change or cancel the program at any time.

faq.q: Does my friend get a bonus too?
faq.a: Usually, yes. The current promotion describes a welcome bonus for the friend after their qualifying spend; check the referral page for the amount on the day they join.

faq.q: Why does my referral still say Pending?
faq.a: Your friend has joined but has not yet made qualifying purchases, or the store has not yet confirmed them.

faq.q: Can I post my link on a deals forum?
faq.a: No. Rakuten's terms specifically name forum pages among the places you may not post your link.

ref-rakuten.publicPostingNote: Links may only be posted on pages you own and control; merchant pages, Facebook pages, forums and paid ads are off-limits.

ref-walmart.summary: The Walmart Affiliate Program pays publishers a percentage of eligible Walmart.com sales they refer through tracked links. It runs on the Impact platform and suits US-focused content sites and creators who write product roundups, shopping guides or how-to content.
ref-walmart.whoItsFor: Adult publishers and creators with a mainly US audience who regularly recommend everyday products. Current Walmart employees cannot join.
howItPays: Affiliates can earn up to 4% on each eligible sale, with category rates shown inside the program, per Walmart's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Commission is based on the sale price excluding shipping, handling, gift wrap, rebates, returns, cancellations and taxes; Sam's Club, pharmacy, travel, financial services, tires and gift cards do not earn, per Walmart's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Payment is made about 90 days after the end of each calendar month for products shipped that month, routed through the platform, per Walmart's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Orders sit in a 60-day locking period for returns, and commission on a returned item is deducted from a later payment, per Walmart's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The cookie window is set in the payout details on the platform rather than in the public agreement, so check it after you join.
eligibility: You must be of legal age where you live (18 or older in most states) and not a current Walmart employee.
Sites that primarily serve a non-US audience are not allowed.
Walmart reviews each application and decides at its own discretion, and it can remove sites at any time.
Membership is free.
steps: 1. Read Walmart's affiliate FAQ and agreement, especially the trademark and paid search rules.
2. Sign up from the Walmart affiliates site, which connects you to Impact.
3. Wait for approval; Walmart advertises a fast review.
4. Use the Affiliate Member Center to create links and banners or pull product data feeds.
5. Add links to product roundups or guides, labeled as paid links.
6. Track monthly net sales and expect a long gap before each payment.
tips: Focus on items people already buy at Walmart, such as household staples and seasonal goods, since the referral window is limited.
Label endorsements with #WalmartPartner or 'paid link', as the agreement asks.
Use the weekly affiliate newsletter for current banners and featured products.
Plan around the roughly three-month payment delay.
watchOuts: No bidding on Walmart trademark keywords, and no pairing Walmart marks with words like sale, coupons or percent off.
Offering rebates, points, sweepstakes entries or any other incentive for using your links is prohibited.
You need written permission before using Walmart links or trademarks in email, spam is banned, and links cannot be posted on Walmart's own Facebook page.
Purchases that come from free or natural search results do not earn commission.

faq.q: Which network runs the Walmart program?
faq.a: Walmart's FAQ names Impact Radius as its affiliate service provider.

faq.q: What happens when a customer returns an item?
faq.a: The commission is deducted from your next payment, or you are invoiced if no payment is pending.

faq.q: Can I list Walmart links on a coupon site?
faq.a: It is risky. The agreement restricts pairing Walmart trademarks with coupon and discount wording and bans incentives, so check with Walmart first.

ref-walmart.publicPostingNote: Approved affiliates may publish links on their own sites and social accounts, without trademark bidding, incentives, unapproved email or coupon-style trademark use.

ref-etsy.summary: Etsy runs two linked programs: Affiliates, for bloggers, media and editorial sites, and Creator Collective, for social media creators. Both pay a percentage of qualifying sales when people click your links and buy from Etsy sellers, with tracking and payments handled through Rakuten. It suits gift guide writers, craft and decor bloggers, and creators who already feature handmade or vintage items.
ref-etsy.whoItsFor: Website publishers who write gift and product content, and social creators with an engaged following on an authorized channel. Etsy sellers can join too.
howItPays: Etsy pays a percentage of qualifying sales but does not publish a fixed rate; rates vary by site type, purchase type and content, per Etsy's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Etsy's help center lists a 30-day cookie for affiliates and 7 days for creators and for sales in the Etsy app, while the affiliate terms list seven days 'subject to change', per Etsy's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Commission excludes tax, shipping, returns and cancellations, and is payable only after the order is validated once Etsy's return window closes, per Etsy's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Payments run through Rakuten by direct deposit, PayPal or cheque.
Attribution is last click: the most recent affiliate link clicked before a sale earns the commission.
eligibility: You must be at least 18, or the age of majority where you live, and each website must be approved separately.
Creator Collective requires at least 500 followers on at least one authorized channel.
Cashback and voucher sites, price comparison sites, forums, dropshipping sites, password-protected sites and sites made mainly to promote Etsy are excluded without written permission.
Partner support is offered in English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.
steps: 1. Pick the program that matches where most of your traffic comes from: Affiliates for websites, Creator Collective for social media.
2. Apply through Etsy's affiliate page or the Creator Collective site and accept Rakuten's terms.
3. Wait for approval and the welcome materials Etsy sends.
4. Create links to specific listings, shops or searches.
5. Publish them in gift guides, tutorials or posts with a clear disclosure.
6. Track commissions in your Rakuten account.
tips: Build themed collections, such as personalized wedding gifts, so readers find something before the cookie runs out.
Link to shops with strong reviews and clear shipping times to reduce returns that cancel commission.
Creators can set up an Etsy Storefront to gather favorite items in one place.
Use only approved, Etsy-issued coupon codes, and keep unreleased codes confidential.
watchOuts: No bidding on Etsy trademark keywords, no Etsy trademarks in paid search and no direct-linking paid search ads to Etsy.com.
Text, SMS and telemarketing are not approved channels, and emails must not look like they come from Etsy or its sellers.
Bots, toolbar traffic, cookie stuffing and misleading links can lead to suspension and withheld commissions.
Etsy's help center and terms give different cookie windows, so do not promise readers a specific window.

faq.q: Can Etsy sellers join?
faq.a: Yes. Sellers can apply to either program and can earn commission on sales from any shop, including their own, subject to Etsy's fraud rules.

faq.q: Which network does Etsy use?
faq.a: Rakuten. Commission shows in your Rakuten account soon after a sale and is paid once the order is validated.

faq.q: Can I add Etsy links to a cashback site?
faq.a: Not without separate written permission from Etsy; cashback and voucher sites are excluded profiles.

ref-etsy.publicPostingNote: Approved affiliates and creators may publish links on authorized channels; cashback, voucher, forum and paid search uses are restricted.

ref-envato.summary: Envato's affiliate program pays a fixed commission when someone you refer takes out an Envato subscription for unlimited creative assets such as templates, fonts, stock video and music. It runs on Impact and suits design, video and web tutorial creators whose audiences use these assets every week. Envato Market and Placeit run their own separate affiliate programs on Impact.
ref-envato.whoItsFor: YouTubers, bloggers, educators and agencies who teach design, video editing, web building or content creation.
howItPays: Monthly subscription referrals pay up to $20, $40 or $80 per month for the first 3 months on the Core, Plus and Ultimate plans, per Envato's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Annual single-payment referrals pay $120 (Core), $250 (Plus) or $500 (Ultimate), with the Ultimate rates applying to all Ultimate plan types, per Envato's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Envato's help center says commission is tracked for referrals within 90 days of a customer clicking your link, per Envato's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
There is no cap on the number of subscribers you can earn on, and payouts are handled through your Impact account.
Only new subscribers count: the customer must never have had an Envato subscription.
eligibility: Open to creators, influencers, publishers, educators and marketers of any size, with manual review by Envato's partnerships team.
You need an Impact account to join and get paid.
Referred customers must be new to Envato subscriptions.
steps: 1. Read Envato's affiliate page and help article to choose the right program: subscriptions, Market or Placeit.
2. Select Join Now to apply through Impact.
3. After approval, create referral links and find banner ads inside Impact.
4. Set up campaign-level tracking so you can see which content performs.
5. Add links to tutorials that actually use Envato assets, with a disclosure.
6. Monitor conversions and payouts in Impact.
tips: Show an asset in use, such as customizing a template on screen, so viewers can judge the value of a subscription.
Annual plans pay more up front; explain honestly when an annual plan makes sense for a viewer and when monthly is wiser.
Use separate tracking links per video or post to learn what converts.
Do not aim offers at existing subscribers, since they will not earn you anything.
watchOuts: Envato's public affiliate page lists FAQ questions about payout timing and referring people you know without showing the answers; read the program terms in Impact before relying on either.
Past or current subscribers do not qualify as new referrals.
Commission figures can change as plans change; trust the current affiliate page over older articles or third-party lists.

faq.q: Does Envato pay recurring commission?
faq.a: Not indefinitely. Monthly plan referrals pay for the first three months, and annual plans pay a single amount.

faq.q: Which network does Envato use?
faq.a: Impact. You need an Impact account, and payouts are handled there.

faq.q: Is Envato Market covered by this program?
faq.a: No. Envato Market and Placeit are separate programs on Impact with their own commission summaries.

ref-envato.publicPostingNote: Affiliates publish links on their own channels; Envato's public pages do not spell out promotion limits, so check the terms in Impact.

ref-fetch.summary: Fetch is a US receipt-scanning rewards app, and its referral program gives both you and a friend bonus points when the friend joins with your code and scans their first receipt. Points can later be redeemed for gift cards and other rewards. It suits people who already use Fetch and know others who would scan their grocery and shopping receipts.
ref-fetch.whoItsFor: Current Fetch users in the US with friends or family who would actually use the app.
howItPays: Fetch says you and your friend typically each get 2,000 points per referral, with higher amounts during some promotions, per Fetch's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The points post once the friend successfully snaps their first receipt and appear in that receipt's point breakdown.
There is no limit on how many people you can refer, per Fetch's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Most rewards need at least 3,000 points to redeem, and first-time redeemers choose from $10, $25 or $50 rewards, per Fetch's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: Fetch is currently available only to shoppers in the United States.
The friend must be new; current users and inactive former users cannot qualify as new users.
Users must be of the age of majority where they live, and each person may hold only one account.
steps: 1. Open the Fetch app and go to the Account tab.
2. Tap Refer a friend to get your code, link and QR code.
3. Send it by text or email to someone who has agreed to hear about Fetch.
4. Ask them to enter your code before snapping their first receipt; downloading through your link may apply it automatically.
5. Check the My referrals tab to see when they qualify.
tips: Tell your friend to enter the code before their first scan, because it cannot be added afterward.
Mention that physical receipts generally need to be scanned within 14 days of purchase.
Explain the redemption minimum so expectations are realistic.
Let the friend know you receive a bonus too; Fetch's terms require you to say so.
watchOuts: Fetch's terms require you to get a person's consent before referring them and to tell them that Fetch is not the sender and that you may earn a bonus.
Referrals of non-existent people or duplicate accounts are void, and Fetch can rescind bonus points already credited.
Points expire after 90 days with no earning or redeeming, following a 30-day notice.
Fetch can void referrals shared in inappropriate social posts and can end the program without notice.

faq.q: What if my friend forgot to enter the code?
faq.a: If they installed through your link, it may have been applied automatically. Otherwise the code has to be entered before the first receipt, so it cannot be added later.

faq.q: Is there a limit on referrals?
faq.a: Fetch's referral page says there is no limit on how many people you can refer.

faq.q: Can I post my code on social media?
faq.a: Fetch's terms allow sharing but let it void referrals from inappropriate posts, and they require each person's consent before you refer them.

ref-fetch.publicPostingNote: Fetch's terms require each person's consent before you refer them and let Fetch void referrals shared in inappropriate social posts.

ref-honey.summary: Honey is PayPal's free browser extension that tests coupon codes at checkout and lets members earn PayPal Rewards points (formerly called Honey Gold) at participating stores. Its refer-a-friend feature gives you bonus points when a friend joins through your invite link and earns points on a first purchase. It suits people who already use Honey and have friends who shop online at supported stores.
ref-honey.whoItsFor: Honey members who can personally recommend the extension to friends who shop online regularly.
howItPays: You get 500 points when a friend who joined through your link earns PayPal Rewards points on a first purchase and those points are confirmed, per Honey's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Honey's help article does not describe a separate sign-up bonus for the friend; they earn the usual points on purchases.
Shopping points usually stay pending for about 60 to 90 days until the store confirms the purchase, so the referral bonus waits too, per Honey's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
In the US, 1,000 points can be redeemed for a $10 gift card at participating stores, or points can be used at PayPal checkout once accounts are connected, per Honey's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The number of referral bonuses you can earn is capped, but Honey does not state the cap publicly.
eligibility: You must be a Honey member and at least 18, or the age of majority where you live.
The friend must be a new user who signs up through your personalized link.
PayPal says you need a PayPal account in good standing to earn and redeem rewards.
Sending invites by email straight from the invite page is a US-only feature; members elsewhere see local redemption options.
steps: 1. Install Honey from its official site or your browser's extension store and sign in.
2. Open the Invite page in your Honey account to find your link and your referral activity.
3. Share the link with friends by email or a personal message.
4. Your friend installs Honey through the link, creates an account and shops at a participating store.
5. Watch the referral show as pending until the friend's first-purchase points are confirmed.
tips: Point your friend toward a store where Honey offers points, since a coupon-only checkout may not earn any.
Expect a wait of a couple of months before referral bonuses post.
Keep earning a few points each year so your balance does not expire.
Explain plainly how Honey works so your friend knows what to expect.
watchOuts: Honey's terms bar earning points through spam, fraud, duplicate accounts, or advertising and other paid promotion.
Points can expire unless you earn at least 10 points in each consecutive 365-day period.
Honey can limit referral points at its discretion and remove points or close accounts for violations.

faq.q: Are Honey Gold and PayPal Rewards points the same thing?
faq.a: Honey's help center now calls them PayPal Rewards points, and PayPal says existing Gold balances remain redeemable.

faq.q: Does my friend have to link a PayPal account?
faq.a: Linking is not required to use Honey, but PayPal says earning and redeeming rewards requires a PayPal account in good standing.

faq.q: Why hasn't my referral bonus arrived?
faq.a: The friend's first-purchase points must be confirmed by the store first, which often takes two to three months.

ref-honey.publicPostingNote: Honey's terms ban spam and paid promotion of referrals but do not say whether unpaid public posts are allowed.

sources.title: Get to know the Honey browser extension

ref-chime.summary: Chime's referral program rewards an existing member and a new member when the new member opens a Chime Checking Account through a personal link and receives a qualifying payroll-type direct deposit. Reward amounts change from one promotion to the next. It suits Chime members whose friends want a mobile checking account and are paid by direct deposit.
ref-chime.whoItsFor: Chime members in good standing with friends who receive paychecks, gig payouts or benefits by direct deposit.
howItPays: Both people can earn a cash reward, but Chime says the referral bonus varies by promotion; the current terms are shown in the Chime app, per Chime's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

The new member needs a qualifying direct deposit of $200 or more within 45 days of opening the account, then must activate the physical Chime Visa debit card within 14 days of that deposit, per Chime's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Rewards are generally paid within 10 business days after all conditions are met, per Chime's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Referrers can be rewarded for up to 10 successful referrals per calendar year, with no limit on invitations sent, per Chime's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Chime's terms say credits of $10 or more are reported on Form 1099-INT for the new member, and certain referrer rewards are reported on Form 1099-MISC, per Chime's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: The referred person must never have opened a Chime Checking Account and must sign up through your exact link; Chime does not use referral or promo codes.

Qualifying deposits are ACH payments from an employer, payroll provider, gig economy payer or benefits payer; bank transfers, peer-to-peer apps, mobile check deposits, cash and one-time deposits such as tax refunds do not count.
The program may not be available in every state, and the referrer's account must be in good standing.
steps: 1. Open the Chime app and find the invite friends section to get your personal link.
2. Read the referral terms linked in the app, since the offer changes.
3. Send the link only to friends who have agreed to receive it.
4. Your friend opens a Chime Checking Account through the link.
5. They move a paycheck or benefits deposit to Chime and activate their card before the deadline.
6. Watch for the reward in your account.
tips: Confirm your friend's pay arrives by ACH from an employer or payroll provider; a transfer from their own bank will not count.
Remind them about the card activation deadline after the first deposit.
Only refer people who actually want a Chime account rather than just the bonus.
watchOuts: Referral rewards can count as taxable income and may be reported on tax forms; keep records and ask a tax professional if unsure. Investing carries risk, and this guide is not investment or financial advice.
Do not use the Chime name in a domain, social profile or ad, and get consent before texting or emailing anyone your link.
Chime can change or cancel referral promotions and end a member's eligibility at any time, with or without notice.

faq.q: Does Chime use referral codes?
faq.a: No. Chime says the new member must sign up through the exact referral link; there are no promo codes.

faq.q: Does a transfer from my friend's other bank count?
faq.a: No. Only ACH deposits from employers, payroll providers, gig payers or benefits payers qualify.

faq.q: Is there a yearly limit?
faq.a: Yes. There is a cap on rewarded referrals each calendar year, though you can send as many invitations as you like.

ref-chime.publicPostingNote: Chime encourages sharing, but its terms require consent before texts or emails and bar Chime-branded domains, profiles or ads.

ref-webull.summary: Webull's referral program rewards existing customers, usually with free stock, when someone they invite opens a Webull brokerage account through their link and makes a first deposit that settles. Reward amounts and deposit requirements change with each promotion and appear in the app. It suits current Webull users who know someone already planning to open a self-directed brokerage account.
ref-webull.whoItsFor: Existing Webull US customers whose friends independently want a brokerage account.
howItPays: Rewards and deposit requirements vary by promotion and are shown in the app's Promotion Center; Webull's help pages do not publish a standing amount, per Webull's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
A referral qualifies once the friend opens a brokerage account through your link and their first deposit shows as Deposit Settled, per Webull's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
You have 30 days to claim a free stock reward, and the shares are deposited within 15 business days after you claim, per Webull's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Free stock comes from a pool of US companies listed on the NYSE or Nasdaq with a market cap of at least $2.5 billion, which Webull says are not recommendations, per Webull's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Reward shares can be sold once they settle, and the proceeds can be reinvested or withdrawn.
eligibility: The friend must never have had a Webull trading account.
They must sign up through your personal referral link; anyone missing from your invite list will not earn you a bonus.
The Promotion Center may not appear in the menu if your account is not eligible for any promotions.
steps: 1. In the Webull app, go to Menu, then Promotion Center, then Referral Bonus.
2. Read the current promotion's rules, including deposit amounts and deadlines.
3. Copy your referral link and share it with someone who has asked about Webull.
4. Your friend opens a brokerage account through the link and makes a first deposit.
5. When their status reads Deposit Settled, claim the reward under My Rewards before the claim window closes.
6. If you have more than one account, set which one receives rewards in Reward Settings.
tips: Do not push a friend to deposit money just to unlock your reward; let them decide based on their own situation.
Claim rewards promptly so they do not lapse.
Check whether rewards will land in your individual brokerage account or an IRA.
Screenshot the promotion terms when your friend signs up in case questions come up later.
watchOuts: Referral rewards, including free stock, can count as taxable income; keep records and check with a tax professional.
Investing carries risk, including the loss of money you put in; reward shares can fall in value, and this guide gives no investment advice.
Unclaimed rewards expire after the claim window.
Promotions change often, so terms you saw earlier may no longer apply.

faq.q: Where do I find my referral link?
faq.a: In the app, under Menu, Promotion Center, Referral Bonus, then Copy My Referral Link or My Invites.

faq.q: Why isn't my friend on my invite list?
faq.a: They probably did not sign up through your link, and Webull says those sign-ups do not earn a bonus.

faq.q: Can I choose which stock I receive?
faq.a: No. Rewards come from Webull's eligible stock pool, and the value or quantity varies by promotion.

ref-webull.publicPostingNote: Webull's help pages do not address public posting of referral links; check the current promotion's terms in the app first.

ref-paypal.summary: PayPal's Invite Friends program rewards you with PayPal Rewards points, not cash, when someone you know opens a new U.S. personal account through your link and then pays for something with PayPal checkout. It is a small, personal program for existing PayPal users.
ref-paypal.whoItsFor: U.S. PayPal personal account holders with a few friends or relatives who shop online but have not signed up yet.
howItPays: You and your friend each receive 1,000 PayPal Rewards points once the friend qualifies, per PayPal's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Rewards are capped at 10 qualifying friends per calendar year, which is where the headline figure of up to 10,000 points comes from, per PayPal's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Your friend qualifies by signing up through your link, adding a bank account or card, confirming a mobile number, and completing an online or in-app PayPal checkout payment of at least $5.00 USD within 30 days of finishing sign-up, per PayPal's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Points show up in the Account Overview area of your PayPal account, and you can spend them at PayPal checkout or on the redemption options offered in the app.
eligibility: Both you and your friend need a U.S. personal PayPal account in good standing.
The friend has to be new to PayPal and must start sign-up from your referral link.
Each new friend can generate only one reward for the whole life of the program.
PayPal alone decides whether a payment qualifies.
steps: Log in to PayPal, open the Invite Friends section, and copy your personal link; skim the current terms, since PayPal can change or end the offer without notice.
Send the link privately, by text, email or direct message, to a friend or relative who does not have a PayPal account.
Your friend signs up through the link, adds a bank account or card, and verifies a mobile number.
Within the qualifying window, your friend pays for an online or in-app purchase with PayPal checkout that meets the minimum amount.
Check Account Overview for the points and redeem them at checkout or in the app.
tips: Explain the purchase window and the minimum checkout amount to your friend up front, so the reward is not lost to timing.
Ask your friend to start from your link, not PayPal's homepage, because the reward depends on it.
Keep a simple list of who you have invited so you know when you are close to the yearly limit.
If points do not appear after the purchase completes, contact PayPal support with its date and amount.
watchOuts: Public posting is off limits: sharing is restricted to family and personal friends or acquaintances, and posting where strangers can see it can void rewards.
A cancelled, refunded or reversed purchase does not count.
Friends beyond the yearly cap earn you nothing until the next calendar year.
Rewards points can count as taxable income in some situations. Keep a record of what you receive, and check with a tax professional if you are unsure how it applies to you.

faq.q: Do I get cash for referring someone?
faq.a: No. The program pays PayPal Rewards points, which you can use at PayPal checkout or for the redemption choices shown in the app.

faq.q: Can I share my link on social media or a coupon site?
faq.a: PayPal's terms say no. The link is meant for people you know personally.

faq.q: My friend already has a PayPal account. Can they still use my link?
faq.a: They will not qualify. The reward is only for people who open a new U.S. personal account through your link.

ref-paypal.publicPostingNote: PayPal's terms limit sharing to family and personal friends and bar posting the link in public places, online or off.

ref-ibotta.summary: Ibotta is a cash back app for groceries and everyday shopping, and its referral program pays you a bonus when a friend joins with your code and completes a first qualifying offer. It works best for regular Ibotta users whose friends already shop at the stores Ibotta covers.
ref-ibotta.whoItsFor: Active Ibotta users with friends or relatives who would use the app on their own phone. It also suits people who like explaining money-saving apps to others.
howItPays: You earn a referral bonus for each friend who signs up with your code and completes a first qualifying offer redemption. Ibotta's help pages do not print a fixed amount, so check the Refer and earn screen in the app for the current figure.
The bonus is typically credited within 24 hours after your friend finishes the required steps, per Ibotta's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
There is no limit on how many friends you can refer, per Ibotta's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Your friend may also be offered a separate welcome bonus. Its terms change regularly and are listed on the Bonuses page in the app.
eligibility: Your friend must be brand new to Ibotta and never have had an account.
Your friend must enter your referral code while creating the account. Ibotta cannot add it afterward.
The new account needs its own device. A phone already linked to another Ibotta account, including yours or a family member's, disqualifies both bonuses.
Each person may have only one earning account, and Ibotta specifically bans making a second account to use your own code.
Some broad offer types may not count as the qualifying first redemption, so check which offers qualify in the app.
steps: Open the Ibotta app, tap your profile at the top left of the Home screen, and choose Refer and earn.
Copy your referral code, or tap the invite option to share a link by text, email or social media.
Your friend installs Ibotta on their own device and types in your code during sign-up.
Your friend unlocks a qualifying offer, buys the item, and submits the receipt (or completes an eligible online purchase).
Once Ibotta approves the first redemption, watch your account for the referral bonus.
tips: Remind your friend to enter the code at sign-up, since a missed code cannot be fixed later.
Suggest a simple in-store offer on something they already buy for the first redemption, so it clears without a long wait.
If your friend's first redemption is an online purchase, warn them that the retailer's pending period can delay the bonus.
Check the app's Bonuses page now and then for limited-time extras tied to referring multiple friends.
watchOuts: Shared devices are a common reason referrals fail, so a spouse or teen using your phone will not count.
Creating a second account to refer yourself breaks Ibotta's rules and can put your account at risk.
When you post your code in a group, forum or social feed, follow that site's own rules on referral codes.

faq.q: Can a family member sign up on my phone with my code?
faq.a: No. The new account has to be on a device that has never been linked to another Ibotta account.

faq.q: My friend forgot to enter my code. Can Ibotta add it?
faq.a: No. Ibotta says referral codes cannot be added once registration is complete.

faq.q: Is there a cap on referrals?
faq.a: Ibotta's own blog says there is no limit on how many friends you can refer.

ref-ibotta.publicPostingNote: Ibotta's blog suggests sharing your code on social media and in online forums, as long as you follow each platform's rules.

ref-swagbucks.summary: Swagbucks is a rewards site and app where members earn points, called SB, for surveys, shopping, scanning receipts and playing games. Its Refer & Earn program gives you an ongoing share of what your referrals earn, plus a one-time bonus when a new member gets off to an active start.
ref-swagbucks.whoItsFor: Swagbucks members who know people interested in earning small rewards from surveys, cash back shopping or receipts, and creators who can explain the site honestly.
howItPays: You earn 10% of each referral's eligible SB earnings for as long as their account stays active, with no maximum, per Swagbucks's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Eligible earnings come from Answer, Shop, Magic Receipts, Discover and Play, including mobile app activity. Sign-up bonuses, Swag Codes, purchased SB, daily goal bonuses, referral bonuses and several other categories do not count, per Swagbucks's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
You get a 300 SB bonus when a referral signs up and earns 300 SB within their first 30 days. This bonus is not available in every country, per Swagbucks's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The one-time bonus is credited the day after your referral qualifies.
Simply sending invitations earns nothing. SB is paid only when someone joins with your code.
eligibility: Your referral must be new. Once someone has registered, they cannot be added to any member's referral list.
Each person may hold only one Swagbucks account.
The one-time bonus depends on your country, so check the Refer & Earn page for what applies to you.
Only earnings from the eligible categories count toward your ongoing share.
steps: Log in at Swagbucks.com and open the Refer & Earn tab near the top of the page, or use the Invite option in the app's menu.
Copy your referral link. You can set a memorable Swag Name to make it easier to share.
Send invitations by email from the Refer & Earn page, add the link to your email signature, or share it on social media.
Your friend signs up through your link and starts earning.
Help them find a few easy activities so they reach the first-month earning goal.
Follow your referral earnings from your account.
tips: A short, accurate video or post about how you actually use Swagbucks is allowed, as long as it does not promise unrealistic rewards.
Invite people likely to stay active, since your ongoing share depends on their continued earning.
Point new members to quick, low-effort tasks such as daily polls or receipt scanning to help them hit the first-month goal.
Put your link in your email signature, which Swagbucks explicitly permits.
watchOuts: Do not email or text strangers, and do not offer payments or gifts to people who sign up with your link.
Paid search ads, domain redirects, pop-unders, link injection and other traffic manipulation are prohibited.
Do not post your link on websites that ban referral links or on any of Swagbucks's own social media pages.
Multiple accounts for one person are not allowed.

faq.q: My friend already joined. Can I add them as my referral?
faq.a: No. Swagbucks says a registered member cannot be added to anyone's referral list.

faq.q: Does my share of a referral's earnings ever stop?
faq.a: Swagbucks describes it as lasting as long as the referral stays active, with no maximum.

faq.q: Do I earn anything just for sending invites?
faq.a: No. You earn only after a friend joins with your code.

ref-swagbucks.publicPostingNote: Swagbucks says you can share your link anywhere, except sites that ban referral links, its own social pages, paid ads, or messages to strangers.

ref-descript.summary: Descript is an audio and video editor that lets you edit a recording by editing its transcript. Its affiliate program, run through PartnerStack, pays a flat commission for each new paying subscriber you send. It suits podcasters, YouTubers and educators who already use Descript and can show it in action.
ref-descript.whoItsFor: Creators with a podcast, YouTube channel, social account, newsletter or course audience who edit audio or video and can demonstrate their real workflow.
howItPays: A one-time, flat $25 USD commission for each new qualifying subscription to Descript Creator or Pro, monthly or annual, per Descript's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
The purchase must happen within 30 days of the first click on your unique link, per Descript's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Commissions apply only to the first subscription term. Renewals do not earn, and older recurring commissions continue only for legacy referrals for a limited period.
Total commissions are capped at $100,000 USD per affiliate per year, per Descript's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Payments come through PartnerStack. Descript's program page says payouts go out monthly to PayPal, while the terms point to PartnerStack's partner terms, so confirm the method in your PartnerStack dashboard.
eligibility: You must be at least 18 and not a resident of a country under U.S. OFAC sanctions.
Descript approves affiliates at its discretion based on brand and audience fit; its page says review takes about a week.
Affiliates from the old platform must reapply on PartnerStack.
Custom-priced packages that are not self-service do not earn commission.
steps: Read the affiliate page and the affiliate terms on Descript's site.
Apply through PartnerStack, describing your main platform, your audience and how you plan to promote Descript.
Wait for approval, then copy your unique affiliate link from the dashboard.
Finish your PartnerStack payout and tax details; Descript may ask for a W-9 or similar form.
Publish content that shows how you use Descript, with a clear affiliate disclosure and your link.
Track clicks and conversions in PartnerStack and adjust what you share.
tips: Show a real edit, such as cleaning up a podcast episode through the transcript, rather than listing features.
Place your link where viewers make decisions, like video descriptions, show notes or a tools page, and refresh it in new content so clicks stay within the attribution window.
Disclose the affiliate relationship plainly every time, as the terms require.
Talk about the plan that fits your audience, since commissions are tied to paid Creator and Pro subscriptions.
watchOuts: Do not bid on Descript's name in search ads or register domains containing its trademarks.
Do not offer discounts, coupons, trials or rebates unless Descript has approved them in writing.
Commissions can be reversed for refunds, cancellations or duplicate orders, and fraud or spam can cost you all past commissions.
Some older pages and summaries still describe a percentage-based recurring commission; the current terms describe a flat fee per new subscriber.

faq.q: Do I earn when my referral renews?
faq.a: No. Under the current terms, commission is paid only on the initial subscription term.

faq.q: How long after a click does a sale still count?
faq.a: The terms count a purchase made within 30 days of the first click on your link.

faq.q: Do I need a large audience to join?
faq.a: Descript does not list a minimum. It reviews each application for brand and audience fit.

ref-descript.publicPostingNote: Public promotion is the point, but brand-keyword ads, unapproved coupons and spam are banned, and you must disclose.

ref-runway.summary: Runway is an AI video generation and editing tool, and Runway Rewards is its affiliate program for creators. Approved partners get a code that gives their audience a discount and earn a flat payment for each new paid subscriber who uses it. It suits creators who make or teach AI video content.
ref-runway.whoItsFor: Creators with an active Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X or similar channel who use Runway and want commission-based income rather than a paid sponsorship.
howItPays: You earn $15 for each new subscriber who buys a paid plan with your code, with no cap on earnings, per Runway's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Your audience gets 25% off any Runway plan when they use your code, per Runway's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Payouts go out on the first of every month through Stripe, and commission continues for as long as your code keeps converting. Every partnership starts with a 3-month pilot, per Runway's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Active partners receive a complimentary Runway Max plan with 9,500 credits that refresh monthly, per Runway's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Separately, Runway's regular refer-a-friend gives both people 1,000 credits if each subscribes to a paid plan within 7 days of sign-up and stays on a paid plan for at least 2 months, per Runway's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: You need an active creator channel; Runway welcomes audiences from under 1,000 followers to over 1 million.
You need a free Runway account, and the application is tied to that account's login email.
The form asks for full links to your channels, your follower tier and the country where your bank account is held.
It is commission-only and not a paid sponsorship; Runway reviews your channel before accepting.
steps: Create a free Runway account if you do not have one.
Fill in the Runway Rewards application with full channel links, follower tier and payout country.
Wait while Runway reviews your channel.
If accepted, start the pilot, get your code and add banking details in the partner dashboard.
Make content about your real Runway work and share your code with its discount.
Check conversions in the dashboard and keep posting through the pilot.
tips: Show the prompt, the settings and the finished clip, so viewers see exactly how you got the result.
Say the code and the discount out loud in videos and pin them in captions, since commission depends on the code being used at checkout.
Disclose that you earn a commission, in line with advertising rules where you live.
Use the complimentary plan's credits to try new features and make fresh tutorials.
watchOuts: A sale only counts when the paid plan is bought with your code, so viewers who forget it earn you nothing.
The partnership begins as a pilot with no long-term lock-in, so either side can end it.
Do not mix up the creator code and the regular refer-a-friend credits; they are separate programs with different rules.

faq.q: Is Runway Rewards a sponsorship?
faq.a: No. Runway describes it as commission-based, with no scripts, posting quotas or required formats.

faq.q: Do I need a big following?
faq.a: No. Runway accepts applications from creators of all audience sizes and reviews the channel itself.

faq.q: How do I get paid?
faq.a: Runway pays monthly through Stripe to the bank details you add in the partner dashboard.

ref-runway.publicPostingNote: Runway Rewards is built for sharing your code publicly on your own channels, with full creative control.

ref-elevenlabs.summary: ElevenLabs makes AI voice tools for text to speech, voice cloning and dubbing. Its Creator Affiliate program, managed on PartnerStack, pays a percentage of what your referred customers spend during their first year. It suits creators, educators and reviewers whose audiences make audio or video.
ref-elevenlabs.whoItsFor: YouTubers, podcasters, course creators and tech writers who use ElevenLabs and can explain it to people likely to buy a paid plan.
howItPays: 22% commission on Starter, Creator, Pro and Scale plan purchases and 11% on Business plan purchases, calculated before tax, for each referred customer's first 12 months, per ElevenLabs's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Enterprise purchases are not eligible, and free sign-ups earn nothing.
A commission becomes active 90 days after the paid sign-up, because of card dispute rights, and then moves to Pending, per ElevenLabs's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Payouts go through PartnerStack between the 1st and 15th of the month once you pass a $5 minimum, per ElevenLabs's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: You must be at least 18, or the age of majority where you live, and a real person rather than an automated account.
You need an active ElevenLabs account and must accept its Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and program terms.
You may hold only one referral account and must provide a valid payment method and tax documents.
ElevenLabs can decline or remove affiliates whose content does not fit its target customers.
steps: Create or sign in to your ElevenLabs account.
Open the ElevenLabs program page on the PartnerStack marketplace and apply.
Once approved, copy your affiliate link from PartnerStack.
Add your payout method and tax details in PartnerStack.
Publish content that shows how you use ElevenLabs, with a clear disclosure next to the link.
Watch the Revenue and Pending figures in PartnerStack.
tips: Demonstrate a real use, such as voicing a tutorial or dubbing a clip, so viewers see whether a paid plan fits their needs.
Put the disclosure right beside the link and say it aloud in videos; the terms say a footer or separate page is not enough.
Expect a delay of several months between a sale and the money, and plan around it.
Aim content at people who need paid tiers, such as regular creators or small teams.
watchOuts: Bidding on ElevenLabs's name or similar terms in search ads, or using them in paid placements, is prohibited.
Self-referrals do not earn; only genuine third-party customers count.
Cookie stuffing, fake coupon promises, impersonating other brands, and bots are banned, and suspicious activity can hold up payments.
ElevenLabs may end your participation after a year with no commission-eligible activity.

faq.q: Why haven't I been paid for my sign-ups?
faq.a: Only paid subscriptions earn, and each commission waits 90 days before it becomes payable.

faq.q: Do Business plan customers count?
faq.a: Yes, at the lower Business plan rate. Enterprise deals do not count.

faq.q: Is there a cookie window?
faq.a: The terms do not state one. Sales must come through your affiliate link and be tracked by ElevenLabs's system.

ref-elevenlabs.publicPostingNote: Public promotion is allowed with a clear, nearby disclosure; brand-keyword ads and misleading claims are banned.

ref-usmobile.summary: US Mobile is a U.S. prepaid mobile carrier, and its refer-a-friend program rewards both you and a friend when the friend switches to US Mobile with their existing number. You choose whether to take the reward as US Mobile account credit or on a prepaid card. It suits current customers whose friends are shopping for a cheaper phone plan.
ref-usmobile.whoItsFor: Existing US Mobile customers with an active paid line who know people ready to move their number from another carrier.
howItPays: You get $30 for each friend who qualifies, and the friend also gets $30, per US Mobile's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

You can take the reward as US Mobile Credits, added almost instantly, or on a US Mobile Rewards Prepaid Mastercard, typically ready within 2 to 4 business days, per US Mobile's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
Credits work only for US Mobile service, apply to autopay renewals, need autopay turned on, and expire 12 months after they are added, per US Mobile's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
There is no limit on how many people you can refer.
You can change the payout choice while a referral is pending; it locks once the referral qualifies.
eligibility: You need an active, paid Warp, Light Speed or Dark Star line and an account in good standing; otherwise rewards are paused until that is fixed.
Your friend must create a new account, bring their existing number to US Mobile, and buy an Unlimited or By the Gig plan on that same line.
The program is for individual customers, not businesses, influencers or large-scale promotions.
Referrals made before July 27, 2026 stay under the older program's archived terms.
steps: Sign in to your US Mobile account dashboard.
Select Rewards in the left column to open the Rewards Center, then choose Refer a friend.
Copy your referral link or code and send it to a friend who is planning to switch carriers.
Your friend opens a new account through your link, transfers their number, and buys an Unlimited or By the Gig plan on that line.
Pick credits or the prepaid card before the referral qualifies.
Check the Rewards Center to confirm the reward.
tips: Remind your friend not to cancel their old service before the number transfer finishes, so the number moves cleanly.
Choose credits if you already pay by autopay; choose the prepaid card if you would rather spend the money elsewhere.
The prepaid card has its own terms, which you accept in your dashboard before redeeming.
Use credits within the year, since they expire.
watchOuts: A friend who takes a brand-new number instead of bringing one over does not qualify.
Influencer-style or large-scale promotion is outside the program's rules.
US Mobile disqualifies referrals when it detects fraudulent activity, and it says it is not responsible for processing delays.

faq.q: Can my friend get a new number and still qualify?
faq.a: No. The friend has to bring their existing number to US Mobile and buy an Unlimited or By the Gig plan on that line.

faq.q: Can I turn credits into cash?
faq.a: No. Credits only pay for US Mobile service, but you can choose the prepaid card instead while the referral is pending.

faq.q: Is there a referral limit?
faq.a: US Mobile says there is no limit to how many people you can refer.

ref-usmobile.publicPostingNote: Sharing by email or social media is fine, but the program excludes influencers, businesses and large-scale promotion.

ref-grant.summary: Grant Cash Advance is a mobile app from Grant Money, LLC, listed on the App Store under Kikoff, that offers small cash advances repaid automatically from your next paycheck or deposit. Grant's public website and Customer Agreement do not describe a referral program, so any invite reward and its rules can only be confirmed inside the app.
ref-grant.whoItsFor: Current Grant users who see an invite offer in the app and want to understand the product before passing it on.
howItPays: Grant's public pages and Customer Agreement did not mention referral or invite rewards when checked on Nov 24, 2026. If the app shows an invite offer, the amount, conditions and payout method on that screen are what apply.

Grant's separate Earn Cash feature lets users collect points from games and surveys and redeem them for cash, with a daily cash-out limit of $500 that may change and redemptions taking up to 3 business days, per Grant's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
For context, Grant's advances range from $25 to $500 for repeat users, with no guaranteed amount, per Grant's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: Anyone you invite has to pass Grant's own checks, which look at account activity, income patterns, linked bank history and repayment behavior; Grant says not everyone qualifies.
Grant's site says its full product set is not offered in Connecticut, Maryland, Nevada, South Carolina or Wisconsin.
Any in-app invite offer sets its own rules on who counts as a new user.
steps: Open the Grant app and look for an invite or referral option; if there is none, there is nothing to share.
Read the full terms of any offer shown and save a screenshot of them.
Read Grant's pricing page and Customer Agreement so you can describe the product accurately.
Share only with someone who has asked about cash advance apps, and send them to the official app store listing.
Your friend signs up and completes Grant's verification on their own.
tips: Describe Grant plainly as a short-term advance that is repaid automatically, not as free money.
Encourage anyone you invite to read the fees and the Customer Agreement before taking an advance.
Never push someone toward an advance to earn a reward.
Keep your screenshot of the offer terms.
watchOuts: Cash advances have fees and repayment terms to read first. Grant lists an optional monthly membership and an extra fee for same-day delivery, and two of its pages describe that delivery fee differently, so check the pricing page and Customer Agreement for current amounts.

Repayment is debited automatically from the linked bank account when money arrives, and Grant's Customer Agreement says it is not responsible for overdraft or similar bank fees caused by those debits.
Referral rewards and other cash rewards can count as taxable income. Keep records, and ask a tax professional if you are unsure.
With no public referral terms, the rules on where you may post a link are unknown.

faq.q: Does Grant have a public referral program?
faq.a: We could not confirm one on Grant's website, pricing page, legal page or Customer Agreement. Any offer would appear inside the app with its own terms.

faq.q: Is a Grant advance a loan?
faq.a: Grant's App Store listing says its cash advance is not a personal loan. Read the Customer Agreement for the exact terms.

faq.q: Do I need the paid membership to get an advance?
faq.a: Grant's site says you can request a standard advance without the membership by emailing its support team.

ref-grant.publicPostingNote: Grant publishes no referral terms on its website, so any posting rules would be in the in-app offer.

ref-freelancer.summary: Freelancer.com is a marketplace for hiring freelancers and running contests. It rewards bringing people in two main ways: a Referral Program that gives site credit or reduced fees when a new buyer you refer spends on the site, and a 0% commission promotion for freelancers who bring their own outside clients.
ref-freelancer.whoItsFor: Freelancers with clients outside the platform, and members who know businesses needing freelance help.
howItPays: Referral Program: you can receive site credit or reduced fees after a new buyer you referred fully releases at least $50 in milestone payments on a new project, or awards a new contest prize, per Freelancer's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

Referral credit cannot be cashed out or transferred and only covers milestones, contest prizes or site fees; Freelancer's general credit rules say promotional credit lasts no more than 30 days unless the promotion says otherwise, per Freelancer's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.

0% commission promotion: when a client you bring opens a new account through your promotional link, your project commission with that client drops from 10% to 0% for future projects, per Freelancer's page, checked Nov 24, 2026. The Hire Me support page describes this waiver as lasting for life while you and that client work together.
An older affiliate terms page still on the site describes a bonus equal to a referred user's net project fees in their first 100 days, per Freelancer's page, checked Nov 24, 2026.
eligibility: Both referrer and referee must be over 16.
For the 0% promotion, the client must never have had a Freelancer account; for the Referral Program, the buyer must not have had an active, paying account in the previous six months.
Referrals must arrive through Freelancer's own promotional links and use unique payment sources.
You may not refer yourself or someone on your IP address, and Freelancer may ask for proof of earlier work with a client you bring.
steps: Log in and click Promote Profile on your profile page to find your referral link, Hire Me sharing options and email signature.
Decide which route fits: the Referral Program for new buyers, or the 0% promotion for your own outside clients.
Send the link directly to clients or contacts you already know.
Your contact creates a new account through the link and posts or awards a project.
Once milestones are released, check your account for credit or the fee waiver, and use any credit before it expires.
tips: Add the referral email signature to messages you already send to existing clients.
Keep invoices from past work with a client, in case Freelancer asks for proof.
Work on referred clients' projects yourself, since the fee waiver does not cover them hiring other freelancers.
Treat site credit as a short-lived discount.
watchOuts: Spam, bulk mailing lists and group email addresses are banned, and spamming can mean permanent account closure without payment of accrued bonus.
The 0% promotion does not apply to contests, and other fees still apply.
Chargebacks, refunds or reversals can reduce rewards, and Freelancer can withdraw a promotion and recover fees if it finds bad faith.

faq.q: Can I cash out referral credit?
faq.a: No. Freelancer says referral credit cannot be withdrawn as cash or transferred.

faq.q: What if my referred client hires someone else?
faq.a: The fee waiver only covers projects between you and that client; their work with other freelancers is charged normally.

faq.q: What is the reference invitation?
faq.a: The Freelancer support pages we could read did not describe a separate reference invitation feature. Ask Freelancer's support chat about it before relying on it.

ref-freelancer.publicPostingNote: Freelancer's affiliate terms ban spam and say you must have a pre-existing relationship with the people you refer.

ref-g2a.summary: G2A is a marketplace where independent sellers list digital game keys, software, gift cards and subscriptions. Its Goldmine program gives every account a reflink; when someone buys through it within the tracking window, you earn a share of the sale. It suits gaming creators and communities that already talk about game deals.
ref-g2a.whoItsFor: Streamers, gaming YouTubers, bloggers and community admins whose audiences buy digital games and want a commission from purchases they influence.
